title: Re-timing mortality risk through individualized modelling of lifespan trajectories
zh_title: 视网膜影像基础模型个体化建模寿命轨迹预测死亡风险
summary: 基于视网膜照片与基础模型的RetiME将视网膜特征映射为个体死亡风险，并在三大洲三个独立外部队列验证。
key_points: 训练于欧洲队列，外部队列覆盖东南亚、欧亚与北美
与全因及特定病因死亡相关，并可预测多种系统与眼部疾病
可重建个体化寿命轨迹，与观察到的死亡结局相关
reason: 三个独立外部队列外部验证+基础模型，属重要档
abstract: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk. RetiME is a deep learning-based biomarker that maps retinal features to individual mortality risks and can reconstruct personalized lifespan trajectories associated with observed mortality outcomes with distinct disease-related mortality patterns.
zh_abstract: 全球迫切需要可负担的大规模健康筛查，以加强老龄化人群的预防性照护。利用低成本、无创的视网膜照片，并借助大型基础模型，我们开发了一种基于深度学习的生物标志物——视网膜死亡等效指标（Retinal Mortality Equivalent，RetiME），可将视网膜特征直接映射到个体死亡风险。RetiME在欧洲队列上训练，并在覆盖东南亚、欧亚大陆和北美的三个独立外部队列中进行外部验证，与全因死亡和特定原因死亡显示出稳健关联，并预测多种全身性疾病和眼部疾病的发生率。至关重要的是，除了静态风险估计之外，RetiME通过重建与观察到的死亡结局（例如死亡年龄）相关的个体化寿命轨迹，重新确定了死亡风险的发生时间。这些轨迹的聚类揭示了不同的死亡模式，涵盖以癌症为主、心脏代谢和神经退行性风险，反映了RetiME捕获的多样衰老通路。可解释性分析显示，RetiME捕获了死亡风险背后的多种生物学和视网膜特征。全基因组分析进一步识别出与RetiME相关的遗传位点。总之，这些发现支持进一步评估将视网膜成像和轨迹建模作为死亡风险综合评估的一个组成部分。RetiME是一种基于深度学习的生物标志物，可将视网膜特征映射到个体死亡风险，并能重建与观察到的死亡结局相关的个体化寿命轨迹，这些轨迹具有不同的疾病相关死亡模式。

title: Predicting different dimensions of fatigue from speech data: a longitudinal study in shift workers
zh_title: 基于语音数据预测疲劳的不同维度：倒班工作者纵向研究
summary: 六国1197名倒班工作者两周内每日两次语音采集，用副语言特征预测急性与慢性疲劳各维度并在留出数据评估。
key_points: 多语言队列1197人、六国、两周每日两次密集纵向设计
副语言语音特征预测急性与慢性疲劳不同方面
在未见过的留出数据上评估，性能接近或超过现有水平
reason: 大样本多国纵向设计并有留出验证，但未报告临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Shift work, or working outside of normal circadian cycles, is associated with both experience of fatigue and poorer long-term physical and mental health. However, current methods for assessing fatigue present several barriers to building understanding of how these risks develop over time within individuals. Here, we explore the potential of momentary speech activity-based fatigue measurement in a large, multi-lingual cohort of shift workers, using an intensive longitudinal study design (twice-daily measurement over two weeks in N = 1197 individuals from six different countries). Paralinguistic speech features were used to predict different aspects of acute and chronic fatigue at each study time-point, with performance assessed in unseen (held-out) data. In the cross-sectional analysis, good (close to or exceeding current state-of-the-art) performance was achieved for both current sleep deprivation and self-reported sleepiness levels. The within-user analysis revealed robust increases in performance, yielding the ability to detect more subjective aspects of fatigue such as pervasive physical and mental exhaustion. These findings offer preliminary support for the utility of using brief momentary speech samples as a low-burden, acceptable, and reliable measure of different aspects of fatigue in high-risk populations such as shift workers.
zh_abstract: 轮班工作，即在正常昼夜节律周期之外工作，既与疲劳体验相关，也与较差的长期身心健康相关。然而，当前评估疲劳的方法在理解这些风险如何在个体内随时间发展方面存在若干障碍。在此，我们采用密集纵向研究设计（来自六个不同国家的N = 1197名个体，为期两周每日两次测量），在大型多语言轮班工作者队列中探索基于瞬时语音活动的疲劳测量的潜力。使用副语言语音特征预测每个研究时间点的急性和慢性疲劳的不同方面，并在未见（留出）数据中评估性能。在横断面分析中，针对当前睡眠剥夺和自我报告嗜睡水平均取得了良好（接近或超过当前最先进水平）的性能。用户内分析显示性能稳健提升，从而能够检测更主观的疲劳方面，如普遍性身心耗竭。这些发现为使用简短瞬时语音样本作为高风险人群（如轮班工作者）不同疲劳方面的低负担、可接受且可靠测量提供了初步支持。

title: Patient attitudes toward artificial intelligence-driven dermatology.
source: PubMed · The Journal of investigative dermatology
zh_title: 患者对AI皮肤科应用态度的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入20项研究，梳理患者对AI皮肤科诊断、皮肤癌筛查与远程皮肤科的态度。
key_points: 纳入2015—2026年20项实证研究，含问卷、访谈与偏好实验
覆盖AI诊断、皮肤癌筛查、图像共享与远程皮肤科场景
患者信任多为条件性，取决于场景与沟通方式
reason: 同行评审系统综述，纳入20项研究结论明确，但属综述档上限6分
abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly being developed for dermatology, but the conditions under which patients trust these tools remain poorly characterized. This Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-guided systematic narrative review synthesizes peer-reviewed empirical studies, published from January 1, 2015 through July 7, 2026, that directly assessed patient or public attitudes toward AI in dermatologic diagnosis, skin-cancer screening, image sharing, teledermatology image-quality support, and related patient-facing workflows. Eligible evidence included qualitative interviews and focus groups, surveys, preference/conjoint or vignette experiments, and early clinical deployments. Twenty studies met the inclusion criteria using the review framework. Across study designs, patients expressed conditional support for dermatology AI but consistently favored dermatologist-supervised AI over autonomous AI, especially for high-stakes diagnostic decisions. Trust was strengthened by visible clinician accountability, clear explanations of AI outputs and uncertainty, privacy safeguards, transparent data use, and evidence that performance is reliable across skin tone and diagnosis. Trust declined when AI was framed as replacing clinicians, when image governance was unclear, or when unequal performance was perceived. These findings support a model of augmented intelligence: dermatology AI should serve the clinical relationship; be subject to human oversight; and be evaluated and reported stratified by skin tone, diagnosis, and care context.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Investigative Dermatology] 人工智能（AI）系统正越来越多地被开发用于皮肤病学，但患者信任这些工具的条件仍缺乏充分描述。这篇遵循《系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目》（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses）指南的系统性叙述综述，综合了发表于2015年1月1日至2026年7月7日期间的同行评议实证研究，这些研究直接评估了患者或公众对AI在皮肤病学诊断、皮肤癌筛查、图像共享、远程皮肤病学图像质量支持及相关面向患者工作流程中的态度。合格证据包括定性访谈和焦点小组、调查、偏好/联合分析或情景实验，以及早期临床部署。按照本综述框架，有20项研究符合纳入标准。在不同研究设计中，患者对皮肤病学AI表达了有条件支持，但始终更倾向于由皮肤科医生监督的AI，而非自主AI，尤其是在高风险的诊断决策中。可见的临床医生问责、对AI输出和不确定性的清晰解释、隐私保障、透明的数据使用，以及性能在肤色和诊断之间可靠的证据，均增强了信任。当AI被描述为取代临床医生、图像治理不明确，或人们认为性能存在不公平时，信任下降。这些发现支持增强智能模型：皮肤病学AI应服务于临床关系；应接受人类监督；并应按肤色、诊断和诊疗情境进行分层评估和报告。

title: AI algorithms and external validation: promises, pitfalls, and a practical blueprint.
zh_title: AI算法外部验证：承诺、陷阱与实践蓝图
summary: 欧洲心脏杂志文章系统讨论AI模型外部验证的价值、常见方法学陷阱及实践建议。
key_points: 外部验证可暴露捷径学习与分布漂移
列举数据泄漏、谱系与患病率不匹配等陷阱
提出可操作的验证蓝图
reason: 方法学述评有实操价值，但属观点类文章，按上限6分
abstract: [European heart journal] External validation involving the testing of a frozen AI model on independent data from other sites, populations, time periods, or devices provides the clearest estimate of intended-use setting performance when those external data are deployment-representative of the expected population, measurement processes, and clinical workflow. It yields realistic estimates of discrimination and calibration, exposes shortcut learning and distribution shift, quantifies clinical utility through decision-analytic measures, and reveals subgroup disparities requiring mitigation. Yet common pitfalls undermine credibility: quasi-external splits with hidden relatedness; spectrum and prevalence mismatch; site, workflow, and hardware effects; label noise and reference-standard drift; analytic flexibility and selective reporting; small, underpowered samples; reliance only on the area under the curve; unreported threshold tuning; and leakage. A practical blueprint emphasizes pre-registration; representative, multi-site cohorts spanning geography, time, and acquisition; prevention of patient and temporal overlap; comprehensive evaluation of discrimination, calibration (including calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, and calibration plots), and net benefit with confidence intervals; pre-specified subgroup and fairness audits; transparent labelling procedures and uncertainty analyses; principled sample-size calculations; and minimal, well-documented model updating (recalibration before revision). Finally, external validation should connect to post-deployment governance via drift detection, performance triggers, and change-control plans, complemented by site-specific local evaluation to ensure safety and reliability across diverse clinical environments. When executed to these standards, external validation transforms promising prototypes into dependable clinical tools, clarifying where a model performs, where it fails, and what adaptations are necessary for safe, equitable, and sustainable use. This framework links statistical evaluation to clinical use, model updating, and post-deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal] 外部验证涉及在来自其他中心、人群、时间段或设备的独立数据上测试一个冻结的AI模型；当这些外部数据在预期人群、测量过程和临床工作流程方面具有部署代表性时，它能提供对预期使用场景性能最清晰的估计。它可产生对区分度和校准的现实估计，揭示捷径学习和分布偏移，通过决策分析指标量化临床效用，并揭示需要缓解的亚组差异。然而，常见陷阱会削弱可信度：存在隐藏相关性的准外部划分；谱系和患病率不匹配；中心、工作流程和硬件效应；标签噪声和参考标准漂移；分析灵活性和选择性报告；样本量小、把握度不足；仅依赖曲线下面积；未报告阈值调优；以及数据泄漏。一个实用蓝图强调：预注册；覆盖地理、时间和采集条件的具有代表性的多中心队列；防止患者和时间重叠；全面评估区分度、校准（包括大尺度校准（calibration-in-the-large）、校准斜率和校准图）以及带置信区间的净获益；预先指定的亚组和公平性审计；透明的标注流程和不确定性分析；有原则的样本量计算；以及最小化且有充分记录的模型更新（先重新校准再修订）。最后，外部验证应通过漂移检测、性能触发器和变更控制计划与部署后治理相连接，并辅以针对特定中心的本地评估，以确保在不同临床环境中的安全性和可靠性。按这些标准执行时，外部验证可将有前景的原型转化为可靠的临床工具，阐明模型在何处表现良好、在何处失败，以及为安全、公平和可持续使用需要哪些调整。该框架将统计评价与临床使用、模型更新和部署后监测联系起来。

title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
zh_title: BrainGFM：面向计算脑影像的生成式基础模型
summary: 预印本提出在约130万张MRI/CT切片上预训练的生成式脑影像基础模型，并在48项下游任务和多中心验证中评估。
key_points: 预训练语料约130万张MRI与CT切片
支持低数据预测合成与图像重建后训练
48项任务提升分割分类，并有多中心验证
reason: 大规模预训练、48项任务与多中心验证，属重要档；预印本不超8。
abstract: Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality. In a human-AI collaboration study, BrainGFM assistance yielded a 14% relative improvement in mean radiologist stroke-subtyping accuracy. These findings support generative priors as a reusable foundation for heterogeneous computational brain-imaging applications.
zh_abstract: 计算脑成像受限于日益多样的任务与稀缺、异质的临床数据之间的不匹配。尽管现有脑基础模型能够迁移预训练表征，但其知识仍纠缠于模型特定特征和固定架构之中。本文提出 BrainGFM，一种生成式基础模型，通过可复用且可重构的脑成像先验，将知识迁移扩展到表征复用之外。BrainGFM 在约 130 万张 MRI 和 CT 切片组成的语料上进行预训练，支持面向低数据预测学习的任务对齐数据合成，以及面向图像重建的任务自适应后训练。在 48 项下游任务中，BrainGFM 在有限监督下改善了分割和分类，并在异质成像条件下实现了高保真图像增强。涉及两家内部中心和四家外部中心、共 4,796 例卒中患者的多中心临床验证，证明了其在围绕卒中队列的三项临床相关任务中的适用性。盲法阅片者评估显示，BrainGFM 生成的 FLAIR 图像在整体诊断质量上接近采集的 FLAIR。在一项人-AI 协作研究中，BrainGFM 辅助使放射科医生卒中亚型分型平均准确率获得 14% 的相对提升。这些发现支持将生成式先验作为异质计算脑成像应用的可复用基础。

title: Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
zh_title: ICU死亡预测中生理轨迹与观测模式的可迁移性
summary: 基于MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV与eICU，分析生理轨迹与测量时点对ICU死亡预测外部迁移的影响。
key_points: eICU外部验证覆盖204家医院
固定观测数量后仍评估测量时点效应
reason: 跨204家医院的大样本外部验证，具备多中心迁移证据，属重要档
abstract: Objective: To distinguish the transferable predictive value of physiological trajectories from that of observation patterns in ICU mortality prediction, and to assess whether measurement timing affects performance independently of observation quantity. Materials and Methods: In-hospital mortality was predicted at 48 hours using MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. Nested representations progressively integrated latest-value snapshots (R1), longitudinal physiological summaries (R2), and measurement frequency and timing features (R3). Models fitted on 7,762 MetaVision patients were evaluated on 21,682 MIMIC-IV patients and 43,878 eICU patients across 204 hospitals. The effect of measurement timing was assessed while holding the number of retained observations constant. Results: Physiological trajectories improved external prediction in eICU (R2-R1 log-loss difference -0.00922, 95% CI -0.01148 to -0.00704). Observation-pattern features improved locally developed eICU models (R3-R2 -0.00257, 95% CI -0.00370 to -0.00146), but not clearly after transfer from MetaVision (-0.00012, 95% CI -0.00206 to +0.00208). R3 was favoured in 10 of 30 source bootstrap refits. At matched observation counts, retaining measurements spread throughout the window reduced log loss relative to random retention by 0.03280 for R3 versus 0.00703 for R2. Removing the final 12 hours increased log loss relative to count-matched random removal by 0.01947 for R3 versus 0.00822 for R2. Under reduced availability, the local R3 increment changed from beneficial to harmful. Discussion: Physiological trajectories transferred more consistently, while observation-pattern features were particularly sensitive to the timing and availability of measurements. Conclusion: Clinical prediction models should be evaluated not only in new patient populations but also under the measurement conditions that supply their inputs.
zh_abstract: 【目的】区分在 ICU 死亡率预测中生理轨迹与观察模式各自的可迁移预测价值，并评估测量时机是否在独立于观察数量的情况下影响性能。【材料与方法】使用 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 预测 48 小时院内死亡率。嵌套表征逐步整合最新值快照（R1）、纵向生理摘要（R2）以及测量频率和时机特征（R3）。在 7,762 名 MetaVision 患者上拟合的模型，在来自 204 家医院的 21,682 名 MIMIC-IV 患者和 43,878 名 eICU 患者上评估。在保持保留观察数量不变的情况下评估测量时机的影响。【结果】生理轨迹改善了 eICU 中的外部预测（R2-R1 对数损失差异 -0.00922，95% CI -0.01148 至 -0.00704）。观察模式特征改善了本地开发的 eICU 模型（R3-R2 -0.00257，95% CI -0.00370 至 -0.00146），但从 MetaVision 迁移后不明显（-0.00012，95% CI -0.00206 至 +0.00208）。在 30 次源数据 bootstrap 重新拟合中，有 10 次更支持 R3。在观察数量匹配时，与随机保留相比，保留分布在整个时间窗内的测量使对数损失降低：R3 为 0.03280，而 R2 为 0.00703。与按数量匹配的随机移除相比，移除最后 12 小时使对数损失增加：R3 为 0.01947，而 R2 为 0.00822。在可用性降低时，本地 R3 增量从有益变为有害。【讨论】生理轨迹迁移得更一致，而观察模式特征对测量的时机和可用性特别敏感。【结论】临床预测模型不仅应在新的患者人群中评估，还应在提供其输入的测量条件下评估。

title: GazeRIB: Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Reader Gaze-Guided Chest X-ray Learning
zh_title: 多读者眼动引导胸片学习的系统评估
summary: 比较 1、3、5、8 位放射科医师眼动引导对胸片 severity 预测的影响，共评估 910 个模型。
key_points: 8 位专家重复阅读同一 80 张胸片
各读者组较无眼动基线宏 F1 提升 5.33–7.47 个百分点
在 2,897 张胸片的独立队列上评估四分类
reason: 系统多读者对照并在独立队列验证，方法对比充分，属重要档；预印本未再上调
abstract: Radiologists' visual attention can supervise medical image learning, but how reader panel composition affects its value remains untested. We evaluated GazeRIB (Gaze-guided Radiologist-Informed Blackout), which masks unviewed regions during training and uses unmasked images at inference. Eight experts repeatedly read the same 80 chest X-rays (CXRs). We compared individual readers with three-, five- and eight-reader panels across seven architectures and 10 seeds, evaluating 910 models on a separate 2,897-CXR cohort for four-class severity prediction. Every panel improved macro F1 over the no-gaze baseline by 5.33-7.47 percentage points (pp; Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.007); no individual reader reached significance on this endpoint. Three readers captured 73-80% of the eight-reader gain in macro F1, the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and the area under the precision-recall curve (AU-PRC). On external validation without retraining, all four panels improved ROC-AUC on SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA by +1.93 to +4.24 pp (p <= 0.004); on MIMIC-Eye no panel differed significantly from baseline, whereas the single-reader average declined (-1.40 pp, p = 0.008). Reader composition therefore influenced performance, although transfer depended on the cohort.
zh_abstract: 放射科医生的视觉注意力可用于监督医学图像学习，但读者小组（reader panel）的组成如何影响其价值仍未被检验。我们评估了 GazeRIB（Gaze-guided Radiologist-Informed Blackout，注视引导的放射科医生知情遮蔽），该方法在训练时遮蔽未被注视的区域，而在推理时使用未遮蔽的图像。八位专家重复阅读了同一批 80 张胸部 X 线片（chest X-rays，CXRs）。我们在七种架构和 10 个随机种子下，比较了单个读者与三人、五人和八人读者小组，并在一个独立的 2,897 张 CXR 队列上对 910 个模型进行四分类严重程度预测评估。每个人数的小组均使宏平均 F1（macro F1）较无注视基线提高 5.33–7.47 个百分点（percentage points，pp；Bonferroni 校正后 p < 0.007）；没有任何单个读者在该终点上达到显著性。三名读者即捕获了八人小组在宏平均 F1、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve，ROC-AUC）和精确率-召回率曲线下面积（area under the precision-recall curve，AU-PRC）上增益的 73–80%。在未经再训练的外部验证中，全部四个小组均使 SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA 上的 ROC-AUC 提高 +1.93 至 +4.24 pp（p <= 0.004）；在 MIMIC-Eye 上，没有任何小组与基线存在显著差异，而单读者平均值则下降（-1.40 pp，p = 0.008）。因此，读者组成会影响性能，尽管其迁移性取决于队列。

title: A prospective randomized study of patient-centered AI for clinical visit preparation
zh_title: 以患者为中心的AI就诊准备：前瞻性随机研究
summary: 在 Google Health 应用中开展前瞻随机研究，802 名美国成人使用大模型就诊准备智能体，在盲法临床评价中优于对照聊天机器人。
key_points: 802 名成人、866 次健康对话的随机对照设计
智能体提供就诊预期、健康信息与优先问题清单
结果由临床医生盲法评价，非临床结局指标
reason: 前瞻性随机设计且大样本、盲法临床评价，属重要档；预印本不高于8
abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: 患者常常在短暂、时间受限的临床就诊中到来时，不确定该期待什么或该问什么；如今数百万成年人转向通用 AI 聊天机器人提前做准备。然而，对话式 AI 是否改善就诊准备度仍不清楚。我们设计了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备智能体，通过在预约前收集临床背景、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、为其临床医生建立按优先级排列的问题列表并生成摘要来指导患者。在 Google Health 应用中进行的一项前瞻性、知情同意的随机研究中，802 名美国成年人与就诊准备智能体（标准版或简版）或基于同一 LLM 构建的、仅给予极少提示的对照聊天机器人进行了 866 次健康相关对话。在盲法临床医生评估和患者自我报告中，就诊准备智能体显著优于对照。在对已完成会话的临床医生审查中（n = 272），该智能体达到全面准备的比例高出 16.6%（67.2% vs. 50.6%；P < 0.05），与患者健康背景一致的比例高出 8.5%（98.9% vs. 90.4%；P < 0.01），同时在所有研究组中保持较高的医学安全性和适当性。患者调查后问卷（n = 460）显示，就诊准备度高出 16.8%（73.8% vs. 57.0%；P < 0.01），对知道该问什么的信心高出 14.3%（81.4% vs. 67.1%；P < 0.01），总体满意度高出 12.0%（74.0% vs. 62.0%；P < 0.05）。临床医生和参与者指标无显著相关性，表明专家审查和患者自我评估捕捉了面向患者的 AI 的互补维度。这些发现表明，LLM 聊天机器人可以安全地帮助患者为临床就诊做准备，遵循结构化工作流程时获益更大，并推动未来关于就诊中沟通和临床结局的研究。

title: With foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification
zh_title: 胃全切片分类的跨院聚合器评估
summary: 5家韩国医院5,036张胃WSI留一医院验证：基于基础模型特征时，聚合器复杂度未提升跨院判别。
key_points: 5家医院5,036张胃部全切片图像
留一医院外部验证比较多种MIL聚合器
CHIME-MIL AUC 0.837，未超过注意力池化
reason: 5院留一外部验证、大样本，阴性结果有参考价值，预印本
abstract: Whole-slide image classifiers are usually developed within one hospital and often go untested at unseen hospitals. We assembled 5,036 haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained gastric slides from five Korean hospitals, scanned at 20x and 40x, and compared multiple-instance learning aggregators under leave-one-hospital-out validation on frozen pathology foundation-model features. A hierarchical patch-region-slide graph aggregator (CHIME-MIL) with site alignment and two-scale fusion reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.837, above six conventional attention and transformer aggregators trained without these steps. Under a matched recipe it did not exceed attention-based pooling, and global max pooling given the same alignment and fusion was better (AUC 0.855, P = 0.0002). The alignment, which subtracts each hospital's mean feature vector without labels, onboarded a new hospital from ten unlabelled slides and cost 0.002 AUC without held-out-hospital data, but its accuracy gains were small and inconsistent. The model had low top-label calibration error (0.053) but under-confident malignancy probabilities, and removing its most-attended patches lowered the malignancy probability far more than removing random patches. With these features, more complex aggregators did not improve discrimination; what a deployable system adds is label-free onboarding, calibration checks and auditable evidence.
zh_abstract: 全切片图像分类器通常在一家医院内开发，并且常常未在未见过的医院中进行测试。我们收集了来自五家韩国医院的5,036张苏木精-伊红染色的胃切片，扫描倍率为20x和40x，并在冻结的病理基础模型特征上，采用留一医院交叉验证比较了多实例学习聚合器。一种带有站点对齐和双尺度融合的分层图像块-区域-切片图聚合器（CHIME-MIL）达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）均值0.837，高于六个未使用这些步骤训练的传统注意力和Transformer聚合器。在相匹配的训练方案下，它并未超过基于注意力的池化；而在相同对齐和融合条件下，全局最大池化表现更好（AUC 0.855，P = 0.0002）。该对齐方法在无标签情况下减去每家医院的平均特征向量，仅用十张未标注切片即可接入一家新医院，并且在无留出医院数据时代价为0.002 AUC，但其准确性提升较小且不一致。该模型具有较低的顶部标签校准误差（0.053），但对恶性概率置信不足；移除其最受关注的图像块比移除随机图像块更大程度地降低了恶性概率。在这些特征下，更复杂的聚合器并未改善判别能力；可部署系统所增加的是无标签接入、校准检查和可审计证据。

title: Identification of local nonlinear shear-wave dynamics using Volterra kernels: application to prostate cancer detection.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 用Volterra核识别局部非线性剪切波动力学检测前列腺癌
summary: 研究提出用Volterra核刻画局部非线性剪切波动力学，经仿真与体模验证后首次用于活体前列腺癌检测。
key_points: 同时建模剪切模量、黏度与非线性三种黏弹特性
方法经计算机仿真与明胶体模验证
首次在活体应用于前列腺癌检测
reason: 新方法但样本与验证规模未详述，无外部对照，属增量档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Cancer remains a major health concern worldwide. Shear-wave elastography (SWE) holds promise for cancer detection by quantifying linear elastic changes in tissue through shear-wave (SW) velocity estimation. However, shear viscosity and nonlinearity are often over-looked, despite their potential as additional biomarkers. This study evaluates the visco-hyperelastic properties of soft tissue, including linear shear modulus, shear viscosity, and shear nonlinearity. We propose using Volterra kernels to characterize local nonlinear SW dynamics, with kernel identification based on SW particle velocity measurements at adjacent locations. The method was validated using in-silico simulations and in-vitro gelatin phantoms. To evaluate its clinical relevance, we applied the method for prostate cancer (PCa) detection. To our knowledge, this is the first in-vivo assessment of voxel-based visco-hyperelastic properties of the prostate. In 90 patients, our results indicated that the linear kernel correlated with the linear shear modulus, while the quadratic kernel reflected both viscosity and nonlinearity. A convolutional neural network trained on these parameters with registered histopathology as ground truth achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.60 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.57, 0.62) and 0.66 (95% CI: 0.64, 0.68) for PCa detection, respectively-both significantly outperforming the linear shear modulus (AUC of 0.54; 95% CI, 0.52 to 0.56). Our findings suggest that Volterra kernels reflect information related to the visco-hyperelastic properties of prostate tissue, highlighting the potential of viscosity and nonlinearity as additional biomarkers for PCa detection.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 癌症仍然是全球主要健康问题。剪切波弹性成像（SWE）通过剪切波（SW）速度估计量化组织的线性弹性变化，有望用于癌症检测。然而，剪切黏性和非线性常被忽视，尽管它们有潜力作为额外生物标志物。本研究评估软组织的黏超弹性特性，包括线性剪切模量、剪切黏性和剪切非线性。我们提出使用Volterra核表征局部非线性剪切波动力学，核识别基于相邻位置的剪切波粒子速度测量。该方法通过计算机模拟和体外明胶模体验证。为评估其临床相关性，我们将该方法应用于前列腺癌（PCa）检测。据我们所知，这是首次对前列腺基于体素的黏超弹性特性进行在体评估。在90例患者中，我们的结果表明线性核与线性剪切模量相关，而二次核反映黏性和非线性。以配准组织病理学为金标准，在这些参数上训练的卷积神经网络用于PCa检测分别达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）0.60（95%置信区间[CI]：0.57，0.62）和0.66（95% CI：0.64，0.68），两者均显著优于线性剪切模量（AUC 0.54；95% CI，0.52至0.56）。我们的发现提示Volterra核反映与前列腺组织黏超弹性特性相关的信息，突显黏性和非线性作为PCa检测额外生物标志物的潜力。

title: Prospective AI-Assisted Screening of Biliary Tract Cancer Using Non-Contrast CT
zh_title: 非增强CT联合AI筛查胆道癌的前瞻性研究注册
summary: 北京清华长庚医院注册前瞻性研究，拟入组1万人验证AI在非增强CT上独立输出胆道癌患者级风险评分的诊断性能。

AI独立分析非增强CT并给出患者级风险评分

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital; conditions: Biliary Tract Cancer (BTC); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 10000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Biliary tract cancer is a group of malignant tumors involving the intrahepatic bile ducts, extrahepatic bile ducts, and gallbladder. Early detection can be challenging because non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT), which is commonly performed in routine clinical practice, may provide limited information for identifying biliary tract cancer. This prospective study aims to clinically validate an artificial intelligence (AI) system for screening and detecting biliary tract cancer on NCCT images. The AI system will independently analyze eligible NCCT examinations and generate a patient-level risk score for biliary tract cancer. The study will evaluate the diagnostic performance of the AI system against a predefined clinical reference standard. The primary objective is to assess the ability of the AI system to distinguish patients with biliary tract cancer from those without biliary tract cancer using NCCT. Secondary objectives include evaluating sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value. The study is designed to evaluate the clinical performance and potential screening value of AI-assisted analysis of NCCT. Routine clinical care and clinical decision-making will not be replaced by the AI system.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：北京清华长庚医院；疾病：胆道癌（BTC）；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：NA；入组人数：10000；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 胆道癌是一组累及肝内胆管、肝外胆管和胆囊的恶性肿瘤。早期检测可能具有挑战性，因为常规临床实践中常用的平扫计算机断层扫描（NCCT）在识别胆道癌方面可能提供的信息有限。这项前瞻性研究旨在临床验证一种用于在NCCT图像上筛查和检测胆道癌的人工智能（AI）系统。该AI系统将独立分析符合条件的NCCT检查，并生成患者层面的胆道癌风险评分。该研究将依据预先定义的临床参考标准评估AI系统的诊断性能。主要目标是评估AI系统利用NCCT区分胆道癌患者与无胆道癌患者的能力。次要目标包括评估敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值和阴性预测值。该研究旨在评估AI辅助分析NCCT的临床性能和潜在筛查价值。常规临床照护和临床决策不会被该AI系统替代。

title: Comparative reasoning in radiology artificial intelligence: longitudinal and reference-case approaches.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)
zh_title: 放射AI中的对比推理：纵向与参考病例方法
summary: 叙述性综述梳理放射AI的纵向对比与参考病例对比推理，并提出能力分级框架。
key_points: 现有放射AI多为单次检查为中心，缺乏跨时间对比
区分纵向推理与参考病例推理两类临床形态
提出从信息获取到轨迹推理的能力层级
reason: 叙述性综述，提出能力框架但无实证数据，按综述上限给5分
abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] Artificial intelligence (AI) in radiology remains predominantly examination-centric, whereas clinical interpretation frequently depends on comparison across time or with relevant prior cases. This narrative review examines comparative reasoning in radiology AI through two related but clinically distinct forms: longitudinal reasoning, which compares examinations from the same patient over time, and reference-case reasoning, which uses clinically analogous cases from other patients to support interpretation. We propose a capability hierarchy that distinguishes simple access to comparative information from higher-level capabilities, including selection of relevant historical context, anatomical and lesion-level correspondence, characterization of interval change, temporal-state interpretation, multi-interval trajectory reasoning, and entity-specific assessment of clinical similarity. This distinction matters because providing prior examinations or retrieving visually similar cases does not itself demonstrate meaningful comparative reasoning. We review developments in prior-examination selection, registration, lesion tracking, temporal vision-language modeling, treatment-response assessment, analogous-case retrieval, and longitudinal report generation. Particular emphasis is placed on evaluation strategies that determine whether model performance depends appropriately on clinically relevant comparative information rather than on additional input volume, global image similarity, acquisition characteristics, or other shortcuts. Key challenges include incorrect prior selection, lesion mismatching, temporal inconsistency, clinically irrelevant reference-case retrieval, data leakage, misleading comparative language, and propagation of historical errors. Future progress will require models that preserve entity identity, reason coherently across multi-visit imaging histories, identify clinically informative reference cases, and demonstrate benefit under realistic clinical conditions. Comparative reasoning is therefore a necessary step in the transition from examination-level toward patient-level radiology AI.
zh_abstract: [《诊断与介入放射学》（Diagnostic and interventional radiology，土耳其安卡拉）] 放射学中的人工智能（AI）仍主要以检查为中心，而临床解读常常依赖于跨时间比较或与相关既往病例的比较。本叙述性综述通过两种相关但在临床上不同的形式考察放射学AI中的比较推理：纵向推理，即比较同一患者随时间推移的检查；以及参考病例推理，即利用其他患者的临床类似病例来支持解读。我们提出一个能力层级，将简单获取比较信息与更高层次能力区分开来，后者包括选择相关历史背景、解剖和病灶层面的对应、间期变化的表征、时间状态解读、多间期轨迹推理，以及实体特异的临床相似性评估。这种区分很重要，因为提供既往检查或检索视觉上相似的病例本身并不表明有意义的比较推理。我们综述了既往检查选择、配准、病灶追踪、时间视觉-语言建模、治疗反应评估、类似病例检索和纵向报告生成方面的进展。特别强调评估策略，这些策略决定模型性能是否适当依赖于临床相关的比较信息，而不是依赖于额外的输入量、全局图像相似性、采集特征或其他捷径。主要挑战包括错误的既往检查选择、病灶不匹配、时间不一致、临床不相关的参考病例检索、数据泄漏、误导性比较语言以及历史错误的传播。未来的进展将需要这样的模型：保持实体身份、在多访视影像历史中进行连贯推理、识别具有临床信息价值的参考病例，并在现实临床条件下证明获益。因此，比较推理是从检查层面放射学AI向患者层面放射学AI转变的必要步骤。

title: Integrating artificial intelligence into medical device quality systems and health-care practice.
source: PubMed · Expert review of medical devices
zh_title: 综述：将AI纳入医疗器械质量体系与临床实践
summary: 该综述梳理AI在医疗器械全生命周期的质量控制、质量保证与监管体系中的应用，并与FDA CSA及ISO 13485协调框架对照。

提及21 CFR 820向QMSR过渡并与ISO 13485协调
健康场景仅作为质量与生命周期示例

abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) are central to safety, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance of medical devices. The transition from 21 CFR 820 to the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) formalizes harmonization with ISO 13485. Artificial intelligence (AI) is being explored in clinical and manufacturing settings and may support medical-device quality and compliance when appropriately validated. This review examines AI applications within QC, QA, and regulatory systems across the product lifecycle. Health-care examples are included only when they illustrate quality, validation, human oversight, or lifecycle-management considerations relevant to medical devices. Clinical and manufacturing applications are discussed in the context of FDA Computer Software Assurance and quality frameworks. A narrative literature search used PubMed, Google Scholar, FDA.gov, EUR-Lex, and IMDRF.org and covered publications from January 2010 through September 2025. AI can shift medical device QC and QA from reactive approaches toward predictive, risk-based paradigms. When integrated within a robust QMS, AI can improve process capability, reduce human variability, and enable earlier detection of quality and compliance risks. Adoption should be guided by regulatory science, clear intended use, lifecycle validation, effective change control, transparency, and sustained human oversight to protect patient safety and maintain regulatory compliance.
zh_abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] 质量控制（QC）和质量保证（QA）对于医疗器械的安全性、有效性和监管合规性至关重要。从 21 CFR 820 向质量管理体系法规（QMSR）的过渡，正式确立了与 ISO 13485 的协调统一。人工智能（AI）正在临床和制造场景中被探索，在得到适当验证的情况下，可能支持医疗器械质量和合规性。本综述考察了产品全生命周期中 QC、QA 和监管系统内的 AI 应用。仅在能够说明与医疗器械相关的质量、验证、人为监督或生命周期管理考量时，才纳入医疗保健示例。临床和制造应用在 FDA 计算机软件保证（Computer Software Assurance）和质量框架的背景下进行讨论。采用叙述性文献检索，使用 PubMed、Google Scholar、FDA.gov、EUR-Lex 和 IMDRF.org，覆盖 2010 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月的出版物。AI 可使医疗器械 QC 和 QA 从被动应对方法转向预测性、基于风险的模式。当整合到稳健的 QMS 中时，AI 可提高过程能力、减少人为变异，并实现质量和合规风险的更早发现。其采用应以监管科学、明确的预期用途、生命周期验证、有效的变更控制、透明性和持续的人为监督为指导，以保护患者安全并维持监管合规。

title: Artificial Intelligence Versus Human Interpretation in Diagnostic Radiology: A Systematic Review of Diagnostic Accuracy and Operational Efficiency.
zh_title: 放射诊断中AI与人工判读准确率系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入21项研究，比较AI独立或辅助判读与人工判读的诊断准确率与运营效率。
key_points: 纳入21项2019年以来的研究
11项比较AI独立与人工判读
6项比较AI辅助与非辅助判读者
reason: 系统综述但未做meta分析，纳入21项研究，属值得一看档
abstract: [Cureus] Rising imaging workload and a shortage of radiology specialists have driven interest in artificial intelligence (AI) to improve diagnostic speed and accuracy. This systematic review, without meta-analysis, describes how AI affects diagnostic accuracy and operational efficiency compared with human interpretation in diagnostic radiology. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) and Cochrane guidance, PubMed, ClinicalKey, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar were searched on 11 April 2026 for studies published from January 2019 onwards. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and a Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies 2 (QUADAS-2)-based risk-of-bias assessment. Twenty-one studies were included: 11 compared standalone AI with human readers, six compared AI-assisted with unassisted readers, and four reported both; 18 evaluated task-specific image-analysis AI and three evaluated generative AI models. Because no subgroup was homogeneous enough to pool, we synthesised results narratively and stratified them by comparison type, AI category, imaging modality, and study quality. Standalone image-analysis AI achieved high sensitivity for fractures and selected chest findings but performed less well on subtle findings and lower-quality images, and in one computed tomography-referenced comparison a radiologist outperformed AI. AI assistance improved reader performance more consistently, particularly among less experienced readers. Generative models did not reach specialist performance on complex tasks. Efficiency gains were concentrated in normal studies, and the only randomised trial found lower mammography screen-reading workload with similar early screening performance. No study assessed patient outcomes, and 18 of 21 studies were retrospective. This evidence supports AI only as a supervised, complementary tool; improvements in diagnostic accuracy should not be equated with clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [Cureus] 影像工作负荷不断上升以及放射科专科医生短缺，推动了对人工智能（AI）的兴趣，以提高诊断速度和准确性。本系统综述（未进行荟萃分析）描述了在诊断放射学中，与人工判读相比，AI 如何影响诊断准确性和运营效率。遵循系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA 2020）及 Cochrane 指南，于 2026 年 4 月 11 日检索 PubMed、ClinicalKey、ScienceDirect 和 Google Scholar，纳入 2019 年 1 月及以后发表的研究。两名评审员独立进行研究选择、数据提取，以及基于诊断准确性研究质量评估 2（QUADAS-2）的偏倚风险评估。共纳入 21 项研究：11 项比较独立 AI 与人类判读者，6 项比较 AI 辅助与无辅助判读者，4 项同时报告两者；18 项评估任务特异性图像分析 AI，3 项评估生成式 AI 模型。由于没有任何亚组同质性足以进行合并，我们以叙述性方式综合结果，并按比较类型、AI 类别、影像模态和研究质量进行分层。独立图像分析 AI 对骨折和部分胸部发现达到高敏感性，但在细微发现和较低质量图像上表现较差，且在一项以计算机断层扫描为参照的比较中，一名放射科医生表现优于 AI。AI 辅助更一致地改善判读者表现，尤其是在经验较少的判读者中。生成式模型在复杂任务上未达到专科医生表现。效率提升集中在正常研究上，且唯一一项随机试验发现乳腺X线摄影筛查判读工作负荷降低，而早期筛查表现相似。没有研究评估患者结局，21 项研究中有 18 项为回顾性研究。该证据仅支持 AI 作为受监督的补充工具；诊断准确性的改善不应等同于临床获益。

title: Artificial Intelligence Use and Training in Residency: Results of a National Family Medicine Survey.
zh_title: 全美家庭医学住院医师 AI 使用与培训调查
summary: 2025 年 ABFM 全国住院医师调查显示，15,259 名应答者中 71.1% 近一月使用过 AI，主要用于医学参考与临床决策支持。
key_points: 最常见用途：医学参考 40.7%、临床决策支持 31.9%、患者诊疗外学习 23.6%
同时调查近六个月是否接受过 AI 使用相关教育
reason: 全国性大样本调查、同行评审，但为描述性自报数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Family medicine] We are in a time of rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical care and medical education. We sought to determine the patterns of use and training in AI among family medicine (FM) residents. The 2025 American Board of Family Medicine (ABFM) National Resident Survey (NRS) was administered in October 2025 to all FM residents who completed the In-Training Exam. Residents were asked about their use of AI in the last month and any education about AI use they received in the last 6 months. Resident demographics were obtained from ABFM administrative databases. A total of 15,259 residents completed the AI questions (response rate: 99.6%) with 10,858 residents (71.1%) reporting they used AI in the last month. The most common uses reported were for medical reference (40.7%), clinical decision support (31.9%), learning outside of patient care (23.6%), and ambient documentation of clinical encounters (21.9%). Only 36% reported any AI education or training in the last 6 months. Most FM residents reported recent use of AI tools, reflecting integration of these technologies into routine educational and clinical activities. However, formal training on AI use appears limited, suggesting a gap between adoption and structured competency development. The widespread use of AI by family medicine trainees has risks and opportunities for our future primary care workforce that will require new critical appraisal skills and new methods for teaching and assessing clinical reasoning.
zh_abstract: [家庭医学] 我们正处于人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在医疗照护和医学教育中被快速采用的时代。我们旨在确定家庭医学（family medicine, FM）住院医师中 AI 使用和培训的模式。2025 年美国家庭医学委员会（American Board of Family Medicine, ABFM）全国住院医师调查（National Resident Survey, NRS）于 2025 年 10 月对所有完成在训考试（In-Training Exam）的 FM 住院医师实施。住院医师被询问过去一个月内 AI 的使用情况，以及过去 6 个月内接受的任何关于 AI 使用的教育。住院医师人口学信息来自 ABFM 行政数据库。共有 15,259 名住院医师完成了 AI 问题（应答率：99.6%），其中 10,858 名住院医师（71.1%）报告过去一个月使用过 AI。报告的最常见用途为医学参考（40.7%）、临床决策支持（31.9%）、患者照护之外的学习（23.6%）以及临床接诊的环境记录（21.9%）。仅 36% 报告过去 6 个月内接受过任何 AI 教育或培训。大多数 FM 住院医师报告近期使用过 AI 工具，反映这些技术已整合到常规教育和临床活动中。然而，关于 AI 使用的正式培训似乎有限，提示采用与结构化能力发展之间存在差距。家庭医学受训者广泛使用 AI 为我们未来初级保健队伍带来风险和机会，这将需要新的批判性评价技能，以及教授和评估临床推理的新方法。

title: A single-cell multimodal foundation model enables cross modality analysis between transcriptome and chromatin
zh_title: 单细胞多模态基础模型实现转录组与染色质跨模态分析
summary: 预印本提出 MUTUAL，冻结 scFoundation 与 EpiAgent，用 300 万配对细胞学习共享 RNA-ATAC 潜空间。
key_points: 冻结两个单细胞基础模型并线性整合模态嵌入
基于 400 个公开多组学数据集 300 万配对细胞训练
在 10 个未参与训练数据集上免重训直接应用
reason: 大规模数据训练且在十个外部数据集免重训验证，但为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Most single-cell studies measure either gene expression or chromatin accessibility, and connecting the two usually requires fitting a model to each study. Here we present MUTUAL (MUltiome Transfer in a Unified Aligned Latent space), which keeps the single-cell foundation models scFoundation and EpiAgent frozen, combines their embeddings with linear summaries of each modality and learns a shared RNA--ATAC space from 3.0 million paired cells of 400 public multiome datasets. Applied without refitting to ten datasets not used for training, MUTUAL matched cells' RNA and ATAC profiles more accurately than methods fitted on other donors of the same dataset, annotated ATAC-only cells more accurately and transferred transcription-factor motif activity to RNA-only cells beyond what cell-type assignment provides. In a maturation series of stem-cell-derived islets, motif activity predicted from RNA largely reproduced the measured stage-wise changes when other libraries of the series served as the reference. MUTUAL makes public multiome data directly usable by single-modality studies.
zh_abstract: 大多数单细胞研究仅测量基因表达或染色质可及性中的一项，而将两者联系起来通常需要针对每项研究拟合一个模型。在此我们提出 MUTUAL（MUltiome Transfer in a Unified Aligned Latent space，统一对齐潜空间中的多组学迁移），该方法保持单细胞基础模型 scFoundation 与 EpiAgent 冻结，将其嵌入与各模态的线性摘要相结合，并从 400 个公开多组学数据集的 300 万个配对细胞中学习一个共享的 RNA–ATAC 空间。在未重新拟合的情况下应用于十个未用于训练的数据集时，MUTUAL 对细胞 RNA 与 ATAC 谱的匹配比在同一数据集其他供体上拟合的方法更准确，对仅 ATAC 细胞的注释更准确，并将转录因子基序活性迁移至仅 RNA 细胞，其效果超出细胞类型指派所能提供的信息。在一个干细胞来源胰岛的成熟系列中，当该系列的其他文库作为参考时，由 RNA 预测的基序活性在很大程度上重现了实测的阶段性变化。MUTUAL 使公开多组学数据可直接被单模态研究使用。

title: A decision-only model as a low-cost judge of medical AI answers
zh_title: 决策式小模型作为医疗AI答案的廉价评判者
summary: 预注册评估用输出结构概率的决策式小模型，在五个临床基准上评判医疗大模型输出，并与专家和前沿模型比较。
key_points: 覆盖HealthBench等五个已验证临床基准
对比专家评分者间一致性与前沿LLM
提出决策模型加廉价LLM的混合方案
reason: 预注册多基准评测有新意，但为预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Background. Testing and deploying medical AI systems at scale already results in more outputs than clinicians can review, and the use of large language models (LLMs) as judges is growing rapidly. Decision-only models, cheap and fast models that return structured probabilities rather than text, offer a potentially scalable option for that goal. Methods. In an OSF pre-registered evaluation, we tested TypeSafe Jev 1.13 as a judge on tasks from five validated clinical benchmarks: rubric grading (HealthBench), planted clinical errors (When Rubrics Fail), risk in AI-written clinical documents (MedVAL), counseling ratings and failures (CounselBench) and physicians' preferences between answers (Real-POCQi). Comparators were expert raters' agreement with each other, OpenAI Decisions, GPT-6 Luna, a proposed hybrid team combining decision models and a cheap LLM and, as frontier comparators, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. The main outcome was plain agreement with the expert label. Results. The test comprised 25,091 units and 213,913 model calls. Jev's agreement with expert labels averaged 64.7% over six tasks. On 3,614 matched units it averaged 66.1%, against 65.0% for Opus and 60.7% for Sol, and it was non-inferior to both on four of six tasks. Jev judged the whole pool in 17 minutes for US$1.46; per judgment, it cost 1/34 of Sol's price and 1/152 of Opus's. A preset cutoff held its false-alarm rate on fresh planted-error answers, and in simulation, reviewing Jev's least-sure answers first found 1.4 times the errors of a random audit. Still, omissions were hard for both: at the same false-alarm rate, Jev missed 55.6% of planted omissions and Opus 48.1%, and Opus caught 8.8 points more planted errors overall. Conclusions. Across more than 200,000 model calls, a decision-only model was non-inferior to two frontier judges on most tasks at a small fraction of their cost and time, while reporting how sure it was of every call. With local cutoffs and expert oversight of omissions and clinical documents, judging every output of a deployed medical AI system becomes more affordable.
zh_abstract: 【背景】大规模测试和部署医疗 AI 系统产生的输出已经超过临床医生能够审阅的数量，而使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的做法正在迅速增长。仅做决策的模型（decision-only models）是廉价、快速、返回结构化概率而非文本的模型，可能为这一目标提供一种可扩展的选择。【方法】在一项 OSF 预注册评估中，我们测试了 TypeSafe Jev 1.13 作为评判者，任务来自五个经过验证的临床基准：评分表评分（HealthBench）、植入临床错误（When Rubrics Fail）、AI 撰写的临床文档中的风险（MedVAL）、咨询评级与失败（CounselBench）以及医生对答案的偏好（Real-POCQi）。对照包括专家评分者彼此之间的一致性、OpenAI Decisions、GPT-6 Luna、一个将决策模型与廉价 LLM 组合的拟议混合团队，以及作为前沿对照的 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5。主要结局是与专家标签的简单一致率。【结果】测试包含 25,091 个单元和 213,913 次模型调用。Jev 与专家标签的一致率在六项任务上平均为 64.7%。在 3,614 个匹配单元上，其平均一致率为 66.1%，而 Opus 为 65.0%，Sol 为 60.7%，并且在六项任务中的四项上不劣于两者。Jev 在 17 分钟内以 1.46 美元评判了整个池；按每次判断计，其成本为 Sol 价格的 1/34、Opus 价格的 1/152。预设截断值使其在新鲜植入错误答案上的误报率保持稳定，并且在模拟中，优先审阅 Jev 最不确定的答案所发现的错误是随机审计的 1.4 倍。尽管如此，遗漏对两者都很难：在相同误报率下，Jev 漏掉了 55.6% 的植入遗漏，Opus 漏掉了 48.1%，并且 Opus 总体上多发现了 8.8 个百分点的植入错误。【结论】在超过 200,000 次模型调用中，一个仅做决策的模型在大多数任务上不劣于两个前沿评判者，而成本和时间仅为其一小部分，同时报告其对每次判断的确定程度。借助本地截断值以及对遗漏和临床文档的专家监督，对已部署医疗 AI 系统的每个输出进行评判变得更加可负担。

title: Triage Advice From General-Purpose Language Models in Health and Everyday Situations
zh_title: 通用语言模型在健康与日常情境中的分诊建议
summary: 预印本横断面研究比较 53 个通用模型配置对 82 条健康与非健康信息的转诊建议与人工评定需求是否一致。
key_points: 53 个模型配置对 41 条健康、41 条非健康信息共生成 4,346 条回复
主要结局为无条件或有条件的专业转诊建议，由人工编码评定
研究未涉及真实患者，聚焦是否需要就医的分诊判断
reason: 多模型大规模横断面评测、有人工对照，但属预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Importance: One adult in 10 has consulted a chatbot for health information within 6 months, and nearly half of users do so to decide whether they need care. Referral regardless of need could add demand on stretched services. Objective: To compare referral to a professional by general-purpose language models in health and non-health situations against the level of contact that human raters judged necessary. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cross-sectional study of 4,346 responses generated in September 2026 by 53 general-purpose model configurations, released between March 2023 and September 2026 and accessed through APIs or run locally, to 82 investigator-written messages (41 health and 41 non-health). No patients were involved. Exposures: Health vs non-health scenario. Main Outcomes and Measures: Professional referral, unconditional or conditional on a future change or on doubt, coded by 3 language models and compared with the level of contact that physicians, pharmacists and 2 technically trained raters judged necessary. Results: Referral occurred in 74.7% of health and 46.3% of non-health responses, more often for health in every configuration (standardized difference, 28.3 percentage points; 95% CI, 18.3-37.0). Where raters judged contact unnecessary, 64.5% of health vs 27.6% of non-health responses recommended a professional (odds ratio, 17.08; 95% CI, 6.14-47.54); most of the health excess was conditional referral (46.3% vs 21.0%), and unconditional referral was 18.1% vs 6.6% (odds ratio, 4.66; 95% CI, 1.43-15.19). Where an in-person assessment was judged necessary, referral was similar (89.6% vs 84.5%). In medicines and physical health, referral was not associated with rated severity (odds ratio per point, 1.16; 95% CI, 0.53-2.55), unlike outside health (3.86; 95% CI, 1.79-8.33). The referral gap was 20.5 percentage points among configurations released in 2023 and 32.2 and 32.3 in 2025 and 2026 (4.8 percentage points per year; 95% CI, 2.3-7.2). Conclusions and Relevance: General-purpose language models referred people to a professional where a visit was needed, in health as outside it, but in health also in 2 in 3 situations that physicians and pharmacists judged manageable without contact, a pattern stronger in newer models. Evaluations of these systems should include whether their advice distinguishes situations that can be deferred or managed at a distance, alongside the referral of serious cases.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】每 10 名成人中有 1 名在过去 6 个月内就健康信息咨询过聊天机器人，近一半使用者这样做是为了判断自己是否需要照护。无论是否需要都进行转介，可能会给本已紧张的服务增加需求。【目的】比较通用语言模型在健康和非健康情境中转介至专业人员的情况，与人类评分者判定所需的接触程度。【设计、设置和参与者】横断面研究，纳入 53 个通用模型配置于 2026 年 9 月生成的 4,346 条回复；这些配置发布于 2023 年 3 月至 2026 年 9 月之间，通过 API 访问或在本地运行，回复针对 82 条研究者撰写的消息（41 条健康消息和 41 条非健康消息）。未涉及患者。【暴露】健康与非健康情境。【主要结局和指标】专业转介，包括无条件转介或以未来变化或存在疑问为条件的转介，由 3 个语言模型编码，并与医生、药师和 2 名受过技术培训的评分者判定所需的接触程度进行比较。【结果】健康回复中 74.7% 发生转介，非健康回复中为 46.3%，在每个配置中健康情境均更常见（标准化差异，28.3 个百分点；95% CI，18.3-37.0）。在评分者判定无需接触的情况下，64.5% 的健康回复对 27.6% 的非健康回复推荐了专业人员（比值比，17.08；95% CI，6.14-47.54）；健康情境的超出部分主要是条件性转介（46.3% 对 21.0%），无条件转介为 18.1% 对 6.6%（比值比，4.66；95% CI，1.43-15.19）。在判定需要面对面评估的情况下，转介率相似（89.6% 对 84.5%）。在药物和身体健康情形中，转介与评定严重程度无关（每分比值比，1.16；95% CI，0.53-2.55），而在健康之外的情形中则不同（3.86；95% CI，1.79-8.33）。2023 年发布的配置中转介差距为 20.5 个百分点，2025 年和 2026 年分别为 32.2 和 32.3 个百分点（每年 4.8 个百分点；95% CI，2.3-7.2）。【结论与意义】通用语言模型在需要就诊时会将人们转介至专业人员，健康情境与健康之外情境均如此，但在健康情境中，对于医生和药师判定无需接触即可处理的情况，也有三分之二情形发生转介，这一模式在较新模型中更强。对这些系统的评估应不仅包括严重病例的转介，还应包括其建议是否能区分可推迟或可远程管理的情境。

title: Preceding organ trajectories guide dynamic reassessment after apparent stabilisation in sepsis
zh_title: 脓毒症器官轨迹指导动态再评估
summary: 预印本用四个ICU数据库19690例成人评估既往器官轨迹对脓毒症恶化再评估的价值。
key_points: 加入既往器官轨迹使再评估捕获从219增至282例
轨迹历史的可用性与更新频率影响再评估效果
去甲肾上腺素治疗者低血压或死亡判别AUROC升至0.6929
reason: 多数据库大样本外部再评估，但为预印本且判别提升有限
abstract: Apparent organ recovery can conceal residual vulnerability in sepsis. Across 19,690 adults in four intensive care databases, we evaluated six-hour deterioration in low-severity organs after transition to single-organ dysfunction. At 2,492 eICU reassessment alerts, adding preceding organ trajectories increased capture from 219 to 282 episodes (28.8%; difference 63, 95% CI 38.0 to 93.5). Reassessment depended on the availability and updating of that history. Withholding half of record batches lost 108.3 captures; adaptation recovered approximately one third, and targeted retrieval increased timely correct nominations from 151 to 163. New measurements modified the value of earlier history, while local calibration and alert scheduling improved external reassessment. Among 813 norepinephrine-treated patients, history improved hypotension-or-death discrimination (AUROC 0.5925 to 0.6929) and, in the fixed-model comparison, concentrated larger estimated recorded exposure reductions across treatment priorities (AUTOC difference 25.68 micrograms/kg, 95% CI 5.23 to 46.16). These findings support retaining organ trajectories for dynamic reassessment and treatment prioritisation.
zh_abstract: 在脓毒症中，明显的器官恢复可能掩盖残余脆弱性。在四个重症监护数据库的19,690名成人中，我们评估了转为单器官功能障碍后低严重度器官的六小时恶化。在2,492次eICU再评估警报中，加入既往器官轨迹使捕获数从219例增加到282例（28.8%；差值63，95% CI 38.0至93.5）。再评估取决于该病史的可用性和更新。扣留一半记录批次损失了108.3次捕获；适应恢复了约三分之一，而定向检索将及时正确提名从151增加到163。新测量改变了对早期病史的价值，而局部校准和警报调度改善了外部再评估。在813名接受去甲肾上腺素治疗的患者中，病史改善了对低血压或死亡的判别（AUROC从0.5925提高到0.6929），并且在固定模型比较中，将更大的估计记录暴露减少集中于治疗优先级上（AUTOC差值25.68微克/千克，95% CI 5.23至46.16）。这些发现支持保留器官轨迹以进行动态再评估和治疗优先级排序。

title: Machine Learning in the Differential Diagnosis of Bipolar and Borderline Personality Disorders: A Scoping Review.
source: PubMed · Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie
zh_title: 机器学习鉴别双相障碍与边缘型人格障碍：范围综述
summary: 范围综述汇总24篇全文研究，考察用机器学习及数据驱动预测方法区分双相障碍与边缘型人格障碍。
key_points: 检索8个数据库及会议论文，筛查2523条去重记录
纳入24篇全文，均为数据驱动的分类或刻画研究
聚焦横断面症状难以区分两类疾病的问题
reason: 范围综述属综述类上限6分，纳入研究仅24篇，方法学梳理为主
abstract: [Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie] BackgroundBipolar disorder (BD) and borderline personality disorder (BPD) are associated with substantial morbidity and can be difficult to distinguish when symptoms are assessed cross-sectionally. This scoping review examines machine learning (ML) and related predictive approaches designed to differentiate the two conditions.MethodsWe searched Ovid MEDLINE, APA PsycInfo, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and selected computer science conference proceedings through July 2, 2026. Full-text peer-reviewed journal articles and conference papers were eligible when they used a data-driven computational or statistical prediction approach to distinguish, classify, or characterize BD and BPD. Of 2,594 records identified, 2,523 unique records were screened, and 24 full texts were assessed. Screening followed the Population, Concept, Context framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance, and preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses extension for scoping reviews.ResultsNine reports met the inclusion criteria. Seven participant-based reports contributed an aggregate of 986 report-level participants, although two reports used overlapping cohorts; one conference paper used synthetic data, and one study analyzed 149,798 Reddit posts. Studies including clinical samples reported BD versus BPD discrimination AUC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) values of 0.67 to 0.91 and accuracies ranging from 61.7% to 90%. These estimates were not directly comparable and were derived from small, often imbalanced samples using heterogeneous internal validation. No model was externally validated in an independent clinical cohort.ConclusionThe evidence remains preliminary and does not support clinical deployment. Reported performance is constrained by small samples, class imbalance, uncertain ground-truth labels, spectrum bias, and reliance on pre-existing diagnoses. Prospective studies in consecutive at-risk cohorts, with transparent reporting and independent external validation, are required.
zh_abstract: [Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie]【背景】双相障碍（bipolar disorder, BD）和边缘型人格障碍（borderline personality disorder, BPD）均与显著发病率相关，当横断面评估症状时可能难以区分。本范围综述考察了旨在区分这两种情况的机器学习（machine learning, ML）及相关预测方法。【方法】我们检索了Ovid MEDLINE、APA PsycInfo、Embase、Web of Science、Scopus、IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library以及部分计算机科学会议论文集，检索截至2026年7月2日。全文同行评审期刊文章和会议论文若使用数据驱动的计算或统计预测方法来区分、分类或刻画BD与BPD，则符合纳入条件。在识别出的2,594条记录中，筛选了2,523条唯一记录，并评估了24篇全文。筛选遵循人群、概念、情境框架、Joanna Briggs Institute指南以及系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目-范围综述扩展（preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses extension for scoping reviews）。【结果】九篇报告符合纳入标准。七篇基于参与者的报告合计贡献了986名报告层面参与者，尽管有两篇报告使用了重叠队列；一篇会议论文使用了合成数据，一项研究分析了149,798条Reddit帖子。纳入临床样本的研究报告BD与BPD区分的AUC（受试者工作特征曲线下面积）值为0.67至0.91，准确率为61.7%至90%。这些估计值不能直接比较，且来自小型、常为不平衡的样本，并使用异质性内部验证。没有模型在独立临床队列中进行外部验证。【结论】证据仍属初步，不支持临床部署。报告的性能受小样本、类别不平衡、真实标签不确定、谱偏倚以及对既有诊断的依赖所限制。需要在连续高危队列中开展前瞻性研究，并进行透明报告和独立外部验证。

title: From Small to Large: Assessing Medical Reasoning, Benchmark Contamination, and Model Size in Language Models
zh_title: 医学推理评测中的基准污染与模型规模
summary: 在4个医学基准共3,076题上评测14个模型，考察题型、基准污染与模型规模对成绩的影响。
key_points: 覆盖6家厂商14个模型，含开源权重模型
对比多选题与开放式提问的表现差异
关注小模型在院内本地部署的可行性
reason: 针对基准污染与题型效应的系统评测，有新意但为预印本、无临床结局
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now answer medical exam questions at or above expert level, but it is unclear whether such scores reflect clinical competence, or are instead affected by the format of the questions being asked (e.g., multiple-choice versus open-ended), prior exposure to the benchmarks, and the difficulty of the questions. These benchmarks are also public and widely used online, which may be resulting in LLM memorization. Models may perform better on questions that they have seen before. It is also not evident whether smaller models, which are more locally deployable in HIPAA-compliant hospital settings, have achieved human performance. In this study, we evaluate fourteen current models from six leading providers, one smaller and one larger model from each provider with two additional open-weight models, on 3,076 questions from four medical benchmarks (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedBullets) under standard multiple choice, the same questions with the answer choices withheld, and reconstruction of a hidden question from its choices alone. In the standard multiple-choice setting, the strongest models exceed the human-expert baseline on MedQA-USMLE and PubMedQA, but the smaller models trail their larger models by 8.7 percentage points and only two of the six pass the human-expert bar on the licensing examination. Withholding the answer choices, however, makes every model struggle: mean accuracy falls from 82.3% to 50.9%, and the two largest drops belong to the medically specialised models. On memorization, the strongest models reconstruct one question in four from the answer choices alone, yet accuracy holds on the questions they cannot reconstruct. We further weigh accuracy against inference cost and test whether ensembling several models improves medical question answering.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）目前在医学考试问题上达到或超过专家水平，但这些分数是否反映临床能力尚不清楚，还是反而受到所提问题形式（例如多项选择题与开放式问题）、此前接触过这些基准以及问题难度的影响。这些基准也是公开的并在网上被广泛使用，这可能正在导致 LLM 记忆。模型可能在以前见过的问题上表现更好。同样不明确的是，那些更适合在符合 HIPAA 的医院环境中本地部署的较小模型，是否已经达到人类表现。在本研究中，我们在来自四个医学基准（MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、PubMedQA 和 MedBullets）的 3,076 个问题上，评估来自六家领先提供者的十四款当前模型（每家提供者一款较小模型和一款较大模型，另加两款开放权重模型），设置包括标准多项选择、相同问题但隐去答案选项，以及仅根据选项重建一个隐藏问题。在标准多项选择设置中，最强模型在 MedQA-USMLE 和 PubMedQA 上超过人类专家基线，但较小模型落后其较大模型 8.7 个百分点，且在执照考试上六款较小模型中只有两款通过人类专家门槛。然而，隐去答案选项会使每个模型都陷入困难：平均准确率从 82.3% 降至 50.9%，而最大的两个降幅属于医学专门化模型。在记忆方面，最强模型仅凭答案选项就能重建四分之一的问题，但在它们无法重建的问题上准确率仍然保持。我们进一步权衡准确率与推理成本，并测试集成多个模型是否能改善医学问答。

title: Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
zh_title: 六款大模型戒烟建议因用户画像而异
summary: 审计六款LLM对12种用户画像回答戒烟问题，发现建议内容随画像显著变化。
key_points: 共收集2880条回答，覆盖6款模型4家厂商
青少年画像获FDA批准戒烟药物提及少32-67个百分点
六款中五款对自称专业者给出更少事实
reason: 预印本但对多模型做系统审计并提出可部署干预，超出小改进档
abstract: Hundreds of millions of people now ask large language model (LLM) chatbots for health advice, which raises a question that is simple to pose and hard to answer: does everyone get the same advice? We audit six widely deployed LLMs from four providers on smoking cessation, a domain with codified clini- cal guidance and substantial public-health stakes, by putting the same four cessation questions to twelve user personas that differ in life stage, self-described expertise, and smoking history, for a total of 2,880 responses. What the models say depends on who appears to be asking. Every model named FDA-approved prescription cessation medications less often to teen personas than to adult personas, by 32 to 67 percentage points, and in five of six models a persona presenting health- care expertise received fewer facts than a persona presenting none. We then evaluate one deployable intervention: a short system prompt specifying a factual floor, the set of core med- ical facts every user should receive when they are relevant, while leaving tone, vocabulary, and framing free to adapt. The prompt narrows persona differences in every model, but its effect on overall fact coverage varies in both magnitude and direction across models, so a prompt validated on one system cannot be assumed to transfer to another. Two cautions frame these results. Equal mention rates are not always the correct clinical target, because prescription cessation pharmacother- apy is not recommended for minors, so a defensible factual floor must be age-aware rather than uniform. And because our personas vary on several attributes at once, we report scenario- level differences rather than isolated effects of age or expertise. We release all 2,880 responses and the analysis code.
zh_abstract: 如今数亿人向大型语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人寻求健康建议，这引出一个提出简单却难以回答的问题：每个人得到的建议都一样吗？我们审计了来自四个提供方的六个广泛部署的LLM在戒烟领域的表现，该领域有成文临床指南且具有重大公共卫生意义；我们向12个在人生阶段、自我描述的专业知识和吸烟史上不同的用户画像提出相同的四个戒烟问题，共获得2,880份回答。模型所说的话取决于看似是谁在提问。每个模型向青少年画像提及FDA批准的处方戒烟药物的频率都比成人画像低32至67个百分点；在六个模型中的五个，呈现医疗专业知识的画像收到的事实少于未呈现任何专业知识的画像。随后我们评估了一种可部署的干预措施：一个简短的系统提示，规定事实底线，即每位用户在相关时应获得的核心医学事实集合，同时让语气、词汇和表述框架保持自由以适应。该提示缩小了每个模型中的画像差异，但其对总体事实覆盖的影响在不同模型间幅度和方向均不同，因此在一个系统上验证的提示不能假定可迁移到另一个系统。对这些结果有两点警示。提及率相等并不总是正确的临床目标，因为处方戒烟药物治疗不推荐用于未成年人，因此可辩护的事实底线必须具有年龄意识，而非统一。并且，由于我们的画像同时在多个属性上变化，我们报告场景层面差异，而非年龄或专业知识的孤立效应。我们发布全部2,880份回答和分析代码。

title: Ensemble Classification and Cancer-Specific Gene Signatures from Quality-Aware Hybrid Gene Selection in TCGA RNA-Seq data
zh_title: TCGA 泛癌基因表达集成分类与癌种特征基因
summary: 基于 10,469 例 TCGA 肿瘤比较五种学习器与三种集成，并在独立 SCAN-B 队列迁移乳腺癌亚型面板。
key_points: 覆盖 33 种肿瘤类型共 10,469 例
用按站点分组交叉验证重做特征选择
乳腺癌亚型面板迁移至 3,273 例独立队列
reason: 样本量大且有独立队列外部验证，但为预印本且方法增量有限
abstract: Gene-expression classifiers of cancer type are usually developed and validated within one cohort using random splits. Starting from a quality-aware hybrid Boruta selector from earlier work, we developed and evaluated ensemble classifiers and cancer-specific gene signatures. Using 10,469 TCGA tumours of 33 types, we compared five learners and three ensembles under decision rules fixed in advance, reran the selection in site-grouped cross-validation, transferred a breast-cancer subtype panel to 3273 tumours of the independent SCAN-B cohort, and built five-gene stage~I tumour versus adjacent-normal panels for nine cancer types. Logistic regression (LR) was the most accurate and best-calibrated single learner (balanced accuracy 0.943 on the locked test set). Stacking added at most 0.006 with 1000 genes but improved on LR in every fold with a minimal 100-gene panel; a hierarchical model did not reduce within-group confusion. Site-grouped validation lowered balanced accuracy by 0.027, almost entirely in colon and rectal cancer (0.008 without them and the untestable LAML). On SCAN-B, the subtype panel reached 0.855, close to the 50 PAM50 genes (0.876). Stage~I panels reached ROC AUC >= 0.99 in held-out patients and detected most later-stage tumours. Ensembles help most with a minimal panel; with 1000 genes, a calibrated linear model suffices.
zh_abstract: 癌症类型的基因表达分类器通常使用随机划分在单个队列内开发和验证。从早期工作中一个质量感知的混合Boruta选择器出发，我们开发并评估了集成分类器和癌症特异性基因特征。使用33种类型的10,469个TCGA肿瘤，我们在预先固定的决策规则下比较了五种学习器和三种集成方法，在按中心分组的交叉验证中重新运行选择，将乳腺癌亚型panel迁移到独立的SCAN-B队列的3273个肿瘤，并为九种癌症类型构建了五基因I期肿瘤对比癌旁正常组织的panel。逻辑回归（LR）是最准确且校准最好的单一学习器（在锁定测试集上的平衡准确率为0.943）。Stacking在1000个基因时最多增加0.006，但在最小100基因panel时在每个折中都优于LR；层次模型没有减少组内混淆。按中心分组的验证使平衡准确率降低0.027，几乎完全发生在结肠癌和直肠癌中（去掉它们以及无法测试的LAML后为0.008）。在SCAN-B上，亚型panel达到0.855，接近50个PAM50基因的0.876。I期panel在留出患者中达到ROC AUC >= 0.99，并检测到大多数后期肿瘤。集成方法在最小panel时帮助最大；在1000个基因时，一个校准后的线性模型就足够。

title: Does Vendor Image Processing Matter? Learning Echocardiography Display Appearance from Native Beamspace Data
zh_title: 厂商图像处理对超声心动图模型的影响
summary: 用 8,406 条记录训练网络从原始 beamspace 数据复现 GE 显示外观，并检验滤波对分割模型的影响。
key_points: 数据来自 605 例患者的 8,406 条记录
beamspace CNN 较逐点亮度映射误差降低 43%
EchoXFlow 与 CAMUS 上滤波训练与评估不匹配时 Dice 最低
reason: 揭示厂商后处理对模型稳健性的影响并开源代码权重，属值得一看档
abstract: Most echocardiography datasets contain vendor-processed images, but processing is often undocumented and may affect model performance and robustness. To address this, we train a small convolutional neural network to reproduce General Electric display appearance from native beamspace brightness-mode ultrasound, using 8 406 recordings from 605 unique patients. The beamspace CNN reduces test mean absolute error by 43% over the optimal pointwise brightness map, outperforms an equivalent Cartesian CNN and runs in real time on a CPU. Across the EchoXFlow and CAMUS datasets, unfiltered training followed by filtered evaluation yields the lowest mean Dice for every class, suggesting filtering may be useful as augmentation when evaluation data are filtered or their processing is unknown. Code and pretrained weights: https://github.com/Ahus-AIM/EchoAppearance
zh_abstract: 大多数超声心动图数据集包含厂商处理后的图像，但处理过程常常缺乏记录，且可能影响模型性能与稳健性。为解决这一问题，我们训练了一个小型卷积神经网络，利用来自 605 名不重复患者的 8 406 段记录，从原始波束空间（beamspace）B 型超声复现 General Electric 的显示外观。与最优逐点亮度映射相比，该波束空间 CNN 将测试平均绝对误差降低 43%，优于等效的笛卡尔 CNN，并可在 CPU 上实时运行。在 EchoXFlow 和 CAMUS 数据集上，未滤波训练后进行滤波评估在每一类别上均得到最低的平均 Dice，提示当评估数据经过滤波或其处理方式未知时，滤波可能可作为数据增强使用。代码与预训练权重：https://github.com/Ahus-AIM/EchoAppearance

title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph: A Geometry and Topology-Aware Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
zh_title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph：癌症生存预测多模态框架
summary: 预印本提出融合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑与临床图学习的多模态框架预测癌症生存。
key_points: 结合病理几何拓扑特征与年龄分期等临床图校正
在8个TCGA/CPTAC队列2364例患者上五折评估
多队列C指数较病理单模态PatchGCN小幅提升
reason: 多队列外部评估但为预印本、指标提升幅度有限，属值得一看档
abstract: We developed TopoHyperClinicalGraph, a multimodal framework combining hyperbolic tissue geometry, persistent topology and clinical graph learning for cancer survival prediction. Pre-extracted UNI2-h features are reduced from 1,536 to 1,024 dimensions using training-fold PCA. A pathology backbone combines hyperbolic neighborhoods with Lorentz-centroid attention pooling. Once frozen, its survival logits are adjusted using persistence descriptors from up to 64 landmarks per slide and sampling controls. A five-node clinical graph then learns a further correction from age, sex, stage, T and N. Five-fold patient-level evaluation covered eight TCGA and CPTAC cohorts with 2,364 patients. Mean validation-selected C-indices for TopoHyperClinicalGraph versus pathology-only spatial PatchGCN were 0.7563 versus 0.7386 in COADREAD, 0.6220 versus 0.5998 in HNSC, 0.6755 versus 0.6535 in BRCA and 0.6409 versus 0.6176 in STAD. CPTAC scores were 0.5984 in HNSC, 0.6060 in PDA, 0.8055 in CCRCC and 0.7192 in LUAD. CPTAC-HNSC used TCGA-initialized adaptation; other CPTAC backbones were trained within their cohorts. Geometry accounted for most pathology-only gains, with smaller persistence effects. Clinical graph fusion exceeded its matched node-wise control in five cohorts, tied in one and scored lower in two; clinical-only prediction exceeded fusion in three CPTAC cohorts. The framework supports separate evaluation of geometric, topological and clinical contributions. All scores were validation-selected; independent testing is needed to establish generalizability.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了TopoHyperClinicalGraph，一个结合双曲组织几何、持久拓扑和临床图学习的多模态框架，用于癌症生存预测。预提取的UNI2-h特征使用训练折PCA从1,536维降至1,024维。病理主干网络将双曲邻域与Lorentz质心注意力池化相结合。冻结后，其生存logits使用每张切片最多64个地标的持久性描述符和采样控制进行调整。然后，一个五节点临床图从年龄、性别、分期、T和N学习进一步校正。五折患者水平评估覆盖了8个TCGA和CPTAC队列，共2,364名患者。TopoHyperClinicalGraph与仅病理的空间PatchGCN相比，验证集选择的平均C指数在COADREAD中为0.7563对0.7386，在HNSC中为0.6220对0.5998，在BRCA中为0.6755对0.6535，在STAD中为0.6409对0.6176。CPTAC评分在HNSC中为0.5984，在PDA中为0.6060，在CCRCC中为0.8055，在LUAD中为0.7192。CPTAC-HNSC使用了TCGA初始化的适应；其他CPTAC主干网络在其各自队列内训练。几何解释了仅病理增益的大部分，持久性效应较小。临床图融合在五个队列中超过其匹配的逐节点对照，在一个队列中持平，在两个队列中评分较低；仅临床预测在三个CPTAC队列中超过融合。该框架支持对几何、拓扑和临床贡献的分别评估。所有评分均为验证集选择；需要独立测试以确定泛化性。

title: Accurate and Auditable ECG Classification via Visibility Graph Neural Networks
zh_title: 可见图神经网络实现可审计心电分类
summary: LYNX-ECG将心搏表示为稀疏可见图，在CODE-Test上宏F1达0.889，并可通过删除波形区域审计预测依据。
key_points: 优于含ECGFounder在内的五个基线，图存储约为全采样图的14%
节点对应具体心电时刻，可删减临床波形区域做审计
传导障碍中预期区域在逾90%正确预测中为最强证据
reason: 预印本，有公开基准对比与可解释性设计，证据仍有限
abstract: Physicians read electrocardiograms (ECGs) from waveform shape and timing, yet accurate deep-learning classifiers rarely show which waveform regions drive their predictions. We introduce LYNX-ECG, a graph neural network that represents each heartbeat as a sparse visibility graph of timestamped turning points. On CODE-Test, LYNX-ECG reaches a macro F1 score of 0.889, outperforming five baselines including the ECGFounder foundation model, while its graphs need about 14% of the storage of graphs built from every sample. Because each node maps to a specific ECG time, we can delete clinically defined waveform regions and alter beat timing to audit predictions. For conduction disorders, the clinically expected region was the strongest evidence in more than 90% of correct predictions. Bradycardia and tachycardia calls follow heart rate with conduction intervals held fixed, and atrial fibrillation calls vanish when beat-to-beat variation is removed. Sparse visibility graphs thus pair accurate ECG classification with clinically grounded, testable explanations.
zh_abstract: 医生通过波形形态和时序读取心电图（ECGs），然而准确的深度学习分类器很少显示哪些波形区域驱动其预测。我们引入 LYNX-ECG，这是一种图神经网络，将每次心跳表示为带时间戳转折点的稀疏可见性图。在 CODE-Test 上，LYNX-ECG 达到 0.889 的宏 F1 分数，优于包括 ECGFounder 基础模型在内的五个基线，同时其图所需存储约为从每个样本构建的图的 14%。由于每个节点映射到特定 ECG 时间，我们可以删除临床定义的波形区域并改变搏动时序以审计预测。对于传导障碍，临床预期区域在超过 90% 的正确预测中是最强证据。心动过缓和心动过速判定随心率变化而传导间期保持固定，而去除逐搏变异后房颤判定消失。因此，稀疏可见性图将准确的 ECG 分类与有临床依据、可检验的解释配对。

title: ReuScope: Auditing Data Reuse and Evaluation Sensitivity in Capsule Vision 2024
zh_title: 胶囊内镜挑战赛数据复用审计
summary: 审计Capsule Vision 2024数据复用，发现训练与验证集跨录影重叠，去除后平衡准确率由82.5%降至61.2%。
key_points: 字节相同文件跨越训练-验证边界
41段Kvasir-Capsule录影同时出现在两分区
去除重叠数据后平衡准确率降至61.2%
reason: 公开数据集审计并量化泄漏影响，但为预印本且范围窄
abstract: We develop ReuScope, a protocol for auditing data reuse and evaluation sensitivity, using Capsule Vision 2024 as a case study. It combines measurements of data relationships with two comparisons: changing the evaluation population while holding predictions fixed, and changing training data while holding evaluation fixed. Byte-identical files cross the public training-validation boundary, and all 41 Kvasir-Capsule recordings that contribute frames occur in both partitions. Shared source recordings establish cross-split overlap; missing cross-recording patient identifiers prevent counting unique shared patients. Across ten paired seeds, removing all training rows attributed to Kvasir-Capsule, plus five rows from other sources flagged as near-matches to it, lowers public-validation balanced accuracy from 82.5% to 61.2%. Evaluating the same fitted models on the validation rows of the other sources reverses the comparison: removal improves balanced accuracy by 1.38 percentage points. The public-validation drop measures sensitivity to source removal, not an amount of leakage-induced inflation. Matched controls show that sample size and class counts alone do not explain the observed score differences. An exploratory experiment removes the training neighbors of validation frames that have close training matches, or equally many distant training rows, and yields a difference-in-differences estimate, relative to matched unflagged frames, of -0.355 percentage points in true-class probability; the paired-t interval for accuracy spans zero. The resulting procedure distinguishes observed reuse from conditional performance sensitivity and specifies the population, class support and uncertainty unit for each conclusion.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了 ReuScope，这是一个用于审计数据复用与评估敏感性的方案，并以 Capsule Vision 2024 作为案例研究。它将数据关系的测量与两项比较相结合：在保持预测不变的情况下改变评估人群，以及在保持评估不变的情况下改变训练数据。字节完全相同的文件跨越了公开训练-验证边界，且所有贡献帧的 41 段 Kvasir-Capsule 记录均同时出现在两个分区中。共享的源记录确立了跨划分重叠；缺少跨记录的患者标识符使得无法统计不重复的共享患者。在十个配对随机种子中，移除所有归因于 Kvasir-Capsule 的训练行，以及来自其他来源、被标记为与其近似匹配的五条行，使公开验证集平衡准确率（balanced accuracy）从 82.5% 降至 61.2%。在其他来源的验证行上评估同样的已拟合模型则逆转了这一比较：移除使平衡准确率提高 1.38 个百分点。公开验证集上的下降衡量的是对来源移除的敏感性，而非泄漏导致的膨胀量。匹配对照显示，仅凭样本量和类别计数无法解释所观察到的分数差异。一项探索性实验移除了与验证帧存在相近训练匹配的训练近邻，或移除同等数量的远距离训练行，得到相对于匹配的未标记帧的双重差分（difference-in-differences）估计为真实类别概率上的 -0.355 个百分点；准确率的配对 t 区间跨零。由此形成的流程可区分已观察到的复用与条件性性能敏感性，并为每个结论规定总体、类别支持度和不确定性单位。

title: RECITE: Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence
zh_title: LLM自动修订临床试验入排标准
summary: 基于ClinicalTrials.gov方案修订构建11,913条数据集，评测15种LLM配置自动生成入排标准修订。
key_points: 覆盖5,735项试验、11,913条实例
评测15种LLM配置含RAG条件
LLM评审经10位领域专家验证
reason: 大规模数据集与专家验证，但为预印本且无外部试验验证
abstract: Overly restrictive eligibility criteria contribute to widespread enrollment failure in clinical trials, yet published recommendations for how specific criteria should be broadened remain disconnected from trial design at scale. We introduce RECITE (Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence), a framework for automated discovery, extraction, and implementation of evidence-based eligibility criteria revisions. RECITE uses protocol amendment documents from ClinicalTrials.gov to construct a dataset of 11,913 curated instances across 5,735 trials, each pairing original criteria with documentary evidence and target revisions. We benchmark fifteen LLM configurations under truncated-to-context-window and retrieval-augmented generation conditions, on a 3,116-instance sample under an LLM-as-judge protocol validated against ten domain experts (judge vs. human quadratic-weighted Cohen's $κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$). The best open-weight model, Gemma 2 9B, achieves $κ_{qw}$-aligned ordinal score $3.0 \pm 0.9$ on a 0--4 scale (normalized 0.742) and the best closed-weight model, GPT-4o, reaches $3.0 \pm 0.8$ (normalized 0.745). Using an agentic literature discovery system, we then identified 44 paper--trial matches across five publications providing trial-design and EC-modification evidence. Our findings suggest that existing clinical knowledge can be operationalized into actionable trial design recommendations.
zh_abstract: 过于严格的入组标准导致临床试验中广泛存在的招募失败，然而已发表的关于应如何放宽具体标准的建议仍与大规模试验设计脱节。我们引入RECITE（Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence，结合文本证据修订入组标准），这是一个用于自动发现、提取和实施基于证据的入组标准修订的框架。RECITE利用ClinicalTrials.gov的方案修订文件构建了一个数据集，包含跨5,735项试验的11,913个精选实例，每个实例将原始标准与文献证据及目标修订配对。我们在截断至上下文窗口和检索增强生成条件下，对十五种LLM配置进行基准测试，测试在3,116个实例样本上进行，采用经十位领域专家验证的LLM-as-judge（LLM作为评判者）协议（评判者与人类之间的二次加权Cohen's κ_qw = 0.694 ± 0.096）。最佳开放权重模型Gemma 2 9B在0–4量表上取得与κ_qw对齐的序数分数3.0 ± 0.9（归一化0.742），最佳闭源权重模型GPT-4o达到3.0 ± 0.8（归一化0.745）。随后，我们使用智能体文献发现系统，在五篇出版物中识别出44个论文-试验匹配，提供了试验设计和EC修改证据。我们的发现表明，现有临床知识可以被操作化为可执行的试验设计建议。

abstract: [Zhonghua yi xue za zhi] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanded its applications in medicine, demonstrating potential in imaging analysis, risk prediction, and decision support. Owing to the complexity of disease patterns and the experience-dependent nature of clinical decision-making, AI holds considerable promise in cervical spine surgery. However, most existing studies remain focused on retrospective modeling and technical validation, with limited evidence supporting clinical usability and generalizability. From a clinically driven perspective, this review summarizes the major application scenarios and developmental trends of AI in cervical spine surgery, and highlights key challenges related to causal inference, data quality, multi-center collaboration, and legal and ethical considerations, aiming to provide a rational basis for the standardized application of AI in this field.

title: MRI-based deep learning model for prediction of Ki-67 expression level in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
zh_title: 基于MRI深度学习的肝内胆管癌Ki-67表达预测
summary: 回顾性研究融合MRI影像与临床数据构建深度学习模型，术前预测肝内胆管癌Ki-67表达水平。
key_points: 回顾性纳入2020至2024年肝内胆管癌病例

reason: 单中心回顾性影像建模，样本与外部验证信息缺失，属增量研究
abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Ki-67 expression is a valuable prognostic indicator in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA). This study aimed to develop a non-invasive Deep learning (DL) model based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical data to predict Ki-67 expression preoperatively. Patients with iCCA between January 2020 and January 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. Based on immunohistochemistry, patients were classified into high-expression group (Ki-67 > 50%) and low-expression group (Ki-67 ≤ 50%). After image acquisition, tumor segmentation, and preprocessing, a 3D-ResNet10 network was utilized for MRI feature extraction. A feed-forward neural network (FFN) was used for clinical feature extraction. Subsequently, the extracted image and clinical features were fused and fed into a lightweight classifier to perform Ki-67 level prediction. The performance of the DL models was evaluated via 5-fold cross-validation using accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity, F1-score, and the area under the curve (AUC). A total of 117 patients were ultimately included (30 cases in the high-expression group and 87 cases in the low-expression group). The model based solely on clinical variables demonstrated limited predictive efficacy (mean AUC: 53.18 ± 14.60%). The model utilizing MRI features alone exhibited high specificity (86.14 ± 10.25%) but modest sensitivity. In contrast, the fused DL model significantly outperformed both individual models, attaining a mean AUC of 84.24 ± 8.82%, an accuracy of 87.17 ± 5.95%, a specificity of 93.07 ± 9.35%, and a markedly improved sensitivity of 70.00 ± 19.44%, yielding a robust F1-score of 73.42 ± 12.28%. We developed and validated a non-invasive DL model integrating contrast-enhanced MRI and clinical parameters that accurately predicts Ki-67 expression in iCCA, demonstrating superior diagnostic performance.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Ki-67表达是肝内胆管癌（iCCA）中有价值的预后指标。本研究旨在开发一种基于磁共振成像（MRI）和临床数据的非侵入性深度学习（DL）模型，以在术前预测Ki-67表达。回顾性分析2020年1月至2024年1月期间的iCCA患者。根据免疫组织化学，将患者分为高表达组（Ki-67 > 50%）和低表达组（Ki-67 ≤ 50%）。在图像采集、肿瘤分割和预处理后，使用3D-ResNet10网络提取MRI特征。使用前馈神经网络（FFN）提取临床特征。随后，将提取的图像特征和临床特征融合，并输入轻量级分类器进行Ki-67水平预测。通过5折交叉验证，使用准确率、精确率、敏感度、特异度、F1分数和曲线下面积（AUC）评估DL模型的性能。最终共纳入117例患者（高表达组30例，低表达组87例）。仅基于临床变量的模型预测效能有限（平均AUC：53.18 ± 14.60%）。仅使用MRI特征的模型表现出高特异度（86.14 ± 10.25%），但敏感度中等。相比之下，融合DL模型显著优于两个单独模型，达到平均AUC 84.24 ± 8.82%、准确率87.17 ± 5.95%、特异度93.07 ± 9.35%，敏感度显著提高至70.00 ± 19.44%，并取得稳健的F1分数73.42 ± 12.28%。我们开发并验证了一种整合增强MRI和临床参数的非侵入性DL模型，可准确预测iCCA中的Ki-67表达，显示出优越的诊断性能。

abstract: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a potentially fatal toxicity of immune checkpoint inhibitors and antibody-drug conjugates. Drug-safety studies in healthcare databases identify ILD with claims-based algorithms that trade positive predictive value (PPV) against sensitivity. We assessed whether large language models (LLMs) improve on these algorithms, with and without electronic health record (EHR) notes, and whether these gains translate into measurable epidemiological benefits. In 309 oncology patients with ILD diagnosis codes at Mass General Brigham, adjudicated by two pulmonologists, we compared 12 open-access LLMs with 20 published claims-based algorithms. LLMs received claims, EHR notes, or both, without task-specific training. Measures were PPV and yield (proportion classified positive). We projected the attenuation of a drug-induced ILD odds ratio under non-differential outcome misclassification. LLMs extended the PPV-yield frontier of the published algorithms with all three inputs. Across the 36 model--input evaluations, LLM PPV exceeded that of the best algorithm without specialist-coding requirements (Algorithm 4) by 14.3 percentage points on average. With claims alone, Qwen3-8B achieved 89.8% PPV (95% CI 78.2-95.6) at 15.9% yield, versus 86.7% at 4.9% for the highest-PPV algorithm. With notes alone, Qwen3-32B achieved 78.9% PPV at 49.2% yield, versus 64.6% at 51.1% for Algorithm~4. With combined claims and notes, Qwen3-14B achieved 100.0% PPV at 24.3% yield. Under a simulated drug-safety scenario with a true odds ratio of 3.0, the projected observed odds ratio was 2.67 with combined inputs versus 1.07 with Algorithm 4, corresponding to a 46-fold difference in the estimated sample size required for 80% power (591 versus 27,200 patients). Zero-shot LLMs offer a higher-PPV alternative to rule-based claims phenotyping for ILD, on all three input types. Because the claims-only configuration uses the same claims data as existing algorithms, it could be deployed in administrative databases without linked notes, and may recover drug-safety signal otherwise lost to outcome misclassification.
zh_abstract: 间质性肺病（Interstitial lung disease，ILD）是免疫检查点抑制剂和抗体-药物偶联物的一种可能致命的毒性反应。医疗保健数据库中的药物安全性研究使用基于理赔数据的算法来识别ILD，这些算法在阳性预测值（positive predictive value，PPV）与敏感性之间进行权衡。我们评估了大语言模型（large language models，LLM）在有和无电子健康记录（electronic health record，EHR）文本记录的情况下，是否优于这些算法，以及这些改善是否转化为可测量的流行病学获益。在Mass General Brigham的309例带有ILD诊断代码的肿瘤患者中（由两名肺科医生裁定），我们将12个开放获取的LLM与20个已发表的基于理赔数据的算法进行比较。LLM接收理赔数据、EHR文本记录或两者，均未进行任务特异性训练。测量指标为PPV和产出率（被分类为阳性的比例）。我们预测了在非差异性结局错分下药物诱导ILD比值比的衰减。在所有三种输入下，LLM都拓展了已发表算法的PPV-产出率前沿。在36项模型-输入评估中，LLM的PPV平均比无需专科编码要求的最佳算法（算法4）高14.3个百分点。仅使用理赔数据时，Qwen3-8B在15.9%的产出率下达到89.8%的PPV（95% CI 78.2–95.6），而最高PPV算法在4.9%的产出率下为86.7%。仅使用文本记录时，Qwen3-32B在49.2%的产出率下达到78.9%的PPV，而算法4在51.1%的产出率下为64.6%。联合使用理赔数据和文本记录时，Qwen3-14B在24.3%的产出率下达到100.0%的PPV。在真实比值比为3.0的模拟药物安全性情景中，联合输入的预计观察比值比为2.67，而算法4为1.07，对应于达到80%把握度所需估计样本量的46倍差异（591例患者 vs 27,200例患者）。零样本LLM在所有三种输入类型上，为ILD提供了比基于规则的理赔表型识别更高PPV的替代方案。由于仅理赔数据的配置使用与现有算法相同的理赔数据，它可以在没有关联文本记录的行政数据库中部署，并可能恢复原本因结局错分而丢失的药物安全性信号。

title: scRM: A single-cell foundation model trained on scRNA-seq reads

We anticipate that scaling this framework and exploring alternative architectures will unlock biological information inaccessible to count models and extend the dataset-specific pretraining it already makes possible.
