title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for Detecting Caregiver Burden in Transcribed Conversations with Clinicians
zh_title: 用机器学习从医患对话记录检测照护者负担
summary: 一项预印本比较四种机器学习/LLM方法，在痴呆照护者与临床医生转录对话中检测照护者负担，效果仅略高于朴素基线。
key_points: 数据来自COPE in PACE研究的去标识转录
LLM提示F1=0.60，弱监督F1=0.58
全监督模型仅1.1%正句，F1=0.25且不可直接比较
reason: 预印本方法比较有基线，但性能提升有限，属值得一看档。
abstract: Dementia caregivers' elevated burden is associated with earlier patient institutionalization and greater caregiver morbidity, yet no standardized, objective method exists for detecting burden during routine clinical encounters. We compared four machine learning and AI approaches for detecting caregiver burden in de-identified caregiver-clinician transcripts from the COPE in PACE study using Zarit burden scores. A naive baseline predicting burden in every transcript achieved precision/F1 = 0.40/0.57. LLM prompting achieved precision/F1 = 0.43/0.60. Weak supervision achieved precision/F1 = 0.48/0.58. The fully supervised model, trained on sentence-level labels with only 1.1% burden-positive sentences, achieved precision/F1=0.19/0.25; this result is not directly comparable because of different labels and units of analysis. LLM prompting modestly outperformed weak supervision and naive baseline without fine-tuning, while class imbalance limited fully supervised sentence-level classification. Larger annotated corpora and refined labeling strategies are needed for clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 痴呆症照护者的负担升高与患者更早被送入机构以及照护者发病率更高相关，然而在常规临床接触中尚无标准化、客观的方法来检测这种负担。我们利用 Zarit 负担评分，在来自 COPE in PACE 研究的去标识化照护者–临床医生转录文本中，比较了四种机器学习和 AI 方法对照护者负担的检测效果。对每份转录文本均预测存在负担的朴素基线，其精确率/F1 = 0.40/0.57。LLM 提示（prompting）达到精确率/F1 = 0.43/0.60。弱监督达到精确率/F1 = 0.48/0.58。完全监督模型在句子级标签上训练（仅 1.1% 的句子为负担阳性），达到精确率/F1 = 0.19/0.25；该结果因标签与分析单位不同而不能直接比较。LLM 提示在未经微调的情况下略优于弱监督和朴素基线，而类别不平衡限制了完全监督的句子级分类。临床部署尚需更大规模的标注语料库和更精细的标注策略。

title: Questioning the Benchmarks: Hidden Circularity in AQ-10 Autism Screening Datasets
zh_title: AQ-10 自闭症筛查数据集存在隐性循环性
summary: 预印本比较六类模型在三个 UCI AQ-10 年龄数据集上的表现，检验高准确率是否源自标签与行为条目循环定义。
key_points: 对比逻辑回归、随机森林、SVM、XGBoost、FT-Transformer、TabNet 六类模型
使用 UCI AQ-10 儿童 n=290、青少年 n=103、成人 n=699 三个变体
重点区分构成标签的行为条目与人口学协变量，评估性能是否虚高
reason: 方法学质疑类预印本，有基线对比但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) screening increasingly relies on machine learning models trained on the AQ-10 and Q-CHAT questionnaire datasets, and these models are widely reported to reach 95 to 99 percent accuracy, so confirming whether that accuracy reflects genuine diagnostic learning is vital. This paper examines whether that accuracy reflects genuine diagnostic learning or is simply an artifact of how the datasets are built. The study compares six model families, namely Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, XGBoost, FT-Transformer, and TabNet, across three UCI AQ-10 age variants: Child (n=290), Adolescent (n=103), and Adult (n=699). Most emphasis is put on separating the behavioral items that define the diagnostic label from the demographic covariates that do not, since the label itself is a threshold applied to those same items. The effectiveness of this separation is measured using a normalized Circularity Index alongside item-only and demographics-only accuracy. Evaluation of the results has shown that item-based accuracy stays at 93.2 to 100 percent even after the pre-computed result score column is removed, while demographics-only accuracy falls to 50.7 to 71.5 percent, at or below the majority-class baseline in every dataset, giving a mean Circularity Index of 0.947. The same pattern is confirmed on two independent domains outside autism screening: DASS-42 depression screening (n=35,481, CI 0.984) and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (n=39,076, CI 0.896). Lastly, a diagnostic heuristic named AutoCirc is introduced to flag this kind of circularity automatically using mutual information, reproducing the manual Circularity Index on three of five datasets, and a constructive eight-of-ten-item AQ-10 short form is proposed as a practical outcome of the same analysis. The results of the study confirm that high reported accuracy on these datasets reflects the scoring arithmetic of the screening instrument rather than a learned diagnostic pattern, though this does not call the AQ-10 into question as a clinical screening tool when used as intended. Further work shall seek to extend this audit to additional screening instruments, such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, and to datasets carrying independent clinical diagnosis labels.
zh_abstract: 自闭症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder, ASD）筛查日益依赖基于 AQ-10 和 Q-CHAT 问卷数据集训练的机器学习模型，且这些模型被广泛报道达到 95% 至 99% 的准确率，因此确认该准确率是否反映真正的诊断学习至关重要。本文检验该准确率是反映真正的诊断学习，还是仅仅是数据集构建方式造成的人为产物。研究比较六个模型家族，即逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、随机森林（Random Forest）、支持向量机（Support Vector Machine）、XGBoost、FT-Transformer 和 TabNet，在三个 UCI AQ-10 年龄变体上：儿童（n=290）、青少年（n=103）和成人（n=699）。重点在于将定义诊断标签的行为条目与不定义标签的人口学协变量区分开，因为标签本身就是应用于这些相同条目的阈值。这种分离的有效性通过归一化循环性指数（Circularity Index）以及仅条目准确率和仅人口学变量准确率来衡量。对结果的评估显示，即使移除预先计算的结果得分列，基于条目的准确率仍保持在 93.2% 至 100%，而仅人口学变量准确率降至 50.7% 至 71.5%，在每个数据集中处于或低于多数类基线，平均循环性指数为 0.947。相同模式在自闭症筛查之外的两个独立领域中得到确认：DASS-42 抑郁筛查（n=35,481，CI 0.984）和 Rosenberg 自尊量表（n=39,076，CI 0.896）。最后，引入一种名为 AutoCirc 的诊断启发式方法，利用互信息自动标记此类循环性，在五个数据集中的三个上复现了手动循环性指数，并提出一种建设性的 10 项中 8 项 AQ-10 简表，作为同一分析的实际成果。研究结果证实，这些数据集上报告的高准确率反映的是筛查工具的评分算术，而不是学习到的诊断模式，尽管这并不使 AQ-10 在按预期用途使用时作为临床筛查工具受到质疑。进一步工作将寻求将此审计扩展到其他筛查工具，如 PHQ-9 和 GAD-7，以及带有独立临床诊断标签的数据集。

title: AI integration for transforming care of patients with liver diseases.
zh_title: AI在肝病诊疗中的应用综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI在肝病领域的应用，并指出传统纤维化评分与预后预测的局限。
key_points: 慢性肝病约占全球死亡4%
传统评分经济可解释但易致漏诊
离散实验室指标或带来人群偏倚
reason: 叙述性综述，无新数据与验证，属综述上限内的增量档
abstract: [Hepatology international] Chronic liver disease is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, accounting for approximately 4% of global deaths. Despite the increasingly complex care of liver disease, conventional scoring systems remain widely used to assess fibrosis and predict clinical outcomes. Although cost-effective and interpretable, these scores have limitations that may contribute to missed diagnoses and delayed treatment. Furthermore, their reliance on discrete laboratory biomarkers may inadequately reflect patients' overall clinical status and may introduce bias across demographic subgroups. This review aims to provide an overview of current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in hepatology. A literature search of PubMed was conducted to identify publications addressing the application of AI in liver disease. The literature was reviewed to examine the use of AI in diagnosis, risk stratification, clinical prioritization, and liver transplantation, as well as its application across liver diseases of different etiologies. Technical challenges and barriers to clinical implementation were also considered. Artificial intelligence models can integrate multimodal data and capture complex, nonlinear relationships, potentially enabling a more comprehensive assessment of patients' physiological status and disease progression than conventional scoring systems. AI has considerable potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy, prognostic assessment, risk stratification, and decision-making in liver transplantation. However, limitations relating to model interpretability, generalizability, data quality, algorithmic bias, and integration into clinical workflows must be addressed to facilitate safe, equitable, and effective implementation in hepatology.
zh_abstract: [Hepatology international] 慢性肝病是全球发病和死亡的主要原因，约占全球死亡的4%。尽管肝病诊疗日益复杂，传统评分系统仍被广泛用于评估纤维化和预测临床结局。这些评分虽具成本效益且可解释，但存在局限性，可能导致漏诊和治疗延迟。此外，它们依赖离散的实验室生物标志物，可能不足以反映患者的整体临床状态，并可能在人口学亚组间引入偏倚。本综述旨在概述人工智能（AI）在肝病学中的当前应用。通过PubMed文献检索识别探讨AI在肝病中应用的出版物。对文献进行综述，以考察AI在诊断、风险分层、临床优先排序和肝移植中的应用，以及其在不同病因肝病中的应用。还考虑了技术挑战和临床实施障碍。人工智能模型可整合多模态数据并捕捉复杂的非线性关系，可能比传统评分系统更全面地评估患者生理状态和疾病进展。AI在提高诊断准确性、预后评估、风险分层和肝移植决策方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，必须解决模型可解释性、泛化性、数据质量、算法偏倚以及融入临床工作流程等方面的局限性，以促进在肝病学中安全、公平和有效的实施。

title: Artificial intelligence applications in microbiota-gut-brain axis research: Implications for Alzheimer's disease.
source: PubMed · Journal of Alzheimer's disease : JAD
zh_title: AI在微生物-肠-脑轴与阿尔茨海默病研究中的应用
summary: 叙述性综述总结AI/ML在肠道菌群与阿尔茨海默病研究中的标志物识别、多组学整合与预测建模。
key_points: 菌群失调经肠-脑轴影响AD病理
AI用于微生物特征与肠型识别
支持早期AD预测与个体化干预
reason: 叙述性综述，无原始数据与验证，属综述档次内的增量
abstract: [Journal of Alzheimer's disease : JAD] Alterations in the gut microbiota (GM) are increasingly implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathogenesis through the microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA), influencing neuroinflammation, amyloid-β deposition, and tau aggregation. The inherent complexity of microbiota data necessitates artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to identify novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets. In this narrative review, we examined AI applications in AD-related GM research, including metataxonomic and metagenomic approaches. AI methods facilitate microbial signature identification and enterotype characterization associated with AD progression, enable multi-omics integration clarifying molecular pathways linking GM dysbiosis to neurodegeneration, support predictive modeling for early AD detection, and inform personalized MGBA-targeted interventions. Employed techniques include classical ML (e.g., random forests) for taxonomic classification, deep learning (e.g., neural networks) for complex pattern recognition, and explainable AI for identifying key bacterial taxa and metabolic functions. Significant challenges persist regarding methodological standardization, larger longitudinal cohorts, and ethical considerations in clinical applications. Future priorities include developing interpretable models, integrating longitudinal multi-omics data to establish causality, and validating AI-derived insights for precision AD prevention and treatment. AI uniquely enables high-dimensional, non-linear analyses that advance understanding of microbiome-brain interactions, though clinical translation requires rigorous validation and interdisciplinary collaboration.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Alzheimer's disease : JAD] 肠道微生物群（GM）的改变日益被认为通过微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）参与阿尔茨海默病（AD）的发病机制，影响神经炎症、淀粉样β蛋白沉积和tau聚集。微生物群数据固有的复杂性需要人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）来识别新的生物标志物和治疗靶点。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们考察了AI在AD相关GM研究中的应用，包括元分类学和宏基因组学方法。AI方法有助于识别与AD进展相关的微生物特征和肠型特征，实现多组学整合以阐明将GM失调与神经退行性变联系起来的分子通路，支持用于AD早期检测的预测建模，并为个性化的MGBA靶向干预提供信息。所用技术包括用于分类学分类的经典ML（如随机森林）、用于复杂模式识别的深度学习（如神经网络），以及用于识别关键细菌分类群和代谢功能的可解释AI。在方法学标准化、更大的纵向队列以及临床应用中的伦理考量方面仍存在重大挑战。未来优先事项包括开发可解释模型、整合纵向多组学数据以确立因果关系，以及验证AI衍生的见解用于AD的精准预防和治疗。AI独特地实现了高维非线性分析，从而推进对微生物组-大脑相互作用的理解，不过临床转化需要严格验证和跨学科合作。

title: Harnessing big data and artificial intelligence for personalized medicine: from multi-omics integration to clinical decision-making.
zh_title: 多组学整合与AI驱动的个性化医学综述
summary: 综述梳理2015–2025年AI在多组学数据整合与临床决策中的应用，指出数据质量、偏倚、可重复性与隐私伦理仍是主要障碍。
key_points: 高通量组学数据挑战传统分析与可视化方法
AI可辅助数据整合与错误识别，但依赖高质量一致数据
数据偏倚、可重复性差与隐私伦理限制其应用
reason: 泛泛综述，无系统检索量化结论，属增量档
abstract: [Personalized medicine] High-throughput technologies generate large and complex biological datasets that can challenge conventional methods of analysis and visualization. Artificial intelligence (AI) can support the analysis and integration of these datasets, provide new analytical approaches, and accelerate biological research. However, reliable AI applications depend on high-quality, consistent data. Technical errors, bias, and deficiencies in analytical methods can produce misleading findings and undermine reproducibility. AI-based approaches may help identify errors and improve data quality, but poor-quality or biased datasets, limited reproducibility, and concerns about privacy and ethics remain important barriers to their use in biological research. A literature search was performed in PubMed for papers published between 2015 and 2025. This review summarizes recent advances in AI for biological data analysis, including its main applications and potential benefits. It also discusses methodological, translational, and ethical challenges that may limit implementation. Particular attention is given to data quality and reliability, alongside the responsible use of AI in biological research and its translation to personalized medicine.
zh_abstract: 【个性化医疗】高通量技术产生大型且复杂的生物学数据集，这些数据集可能挑战传统的分析和可视化方法。人工智能（AI）可支持这些数据集的分析与整合，提供新的分析方法，并加速生物学研究。然而，可靠的 AI 应用依赖于高质量、一致的数据。技术错误、偏倚以及分析方法的缺陷可能产生误导性发现并削弱可重复性。基于 AI 的方法可能有助于识别错误并提高数据质量，但低质量或有偏倚的数据集、有限的可重复性以及对隐私和伦理的担忧，仍是其在生物学研究中应用的重要障碍。在 PubMed 中对 2015 年至 2025 年间发表的论文进行了文献检索。本综述总结了 AI 用于生物学数据分析的最新进展，包括其主要应用和潜在益处。还讨论了可能限制实施的方法学、转化和伦理挑战。特别关注数据质量和可靠性，以及 AI 在生物学研究中的负责任使用及其向个性化医疗的转化。

summary: 预印本把基因表达到病理图像的合成重构为预测病理基础模型嵌入，以降低训练成本并对标GeneFlow。
key_points: 轻量基因token变换器预测图像嵌入
冻结或LoRA扩散解码器渲染图像
在Xenium基准上与GeneFlow对比
reason: 有新方法且有基线对比的预印本，但未提及代码开放与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression while preserving where each cell sits in the tissue. The inverse, what a given transcriptomic state looks like, is less explored but equally useful: it lets researchers visualize the morphological consequence of a molecular state and interpret a spatial assay's molecular calls against real tissue structure. GeneFlow, the current state of the art on the Xenium gene expression-to-image benchmark, trains a model from scratch, incurring a high cost on every new target dataset it is applied to. We instead propose GESTALT, which reformulates gene expression-to-image synthesis as predicting a pathology foundation model's image embedding. A lightweight gene-token transformer predicts this embedding from multi-cell gene expression, and a frozen or LoRA-adapted diffusion decoder (PixCell) renders it as an image. Because this visual knowledge is reused rather than relearned, GESTALT trains in a fraction of the time. In both multi-cell and single-cell settings, our method outperforms the SoTA on perceptual metrics across all three Xenium datasets. Beyond improved image quality, GESTALT natively synthesizes at 1024 x 1024, and is evaluated in three generalization settings: zero-shot transfer across gene panels and datasets, held-out patients and disease states, and transfer across studies and tissue sources. Coupled with a statistical model of spatial expression, GESTALT also provides, to our knowledge, the first paired synthesis of cell-resolved transcriptomic fields and tissue images with explicit control over cell type, density, and composition. Code is available at https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学在测量基因表达的同时保留每个细胞在组织中的位置。其逆过程，即给定转录组状态看起来是什么样，研究较少但同样有用：它使研究人员能够可视化分子状态的形态学后果，并将空间检测的分子判定与真实组织结构进行对照。GeneFlow是Xenium基因表达到图像基准上的当前最先进方法，它从头训练模型，在应用于每个新的目标数据集时都产生高成本。我们转而提出GESTALT，将基因表达到图像的合成重新表述为预测病理学基础模型的图像嵌入。一个轻量级基因token transformer从多细胞基因表达预测该嵌入，并由冻结或LoRA适配的扩散解码器（PixCell）将其渲染为图像。由于这种视觉知识被重用而非重新学习，GESTALT的训练时间仅为一小部分。在多细胞和单细胞设置中，我们的方法在全部三个Xenium数据集上的感知指标均优于SoTA。除图像质量改善外，GESTALT原生以1024 x 1024进行合成，并在三种泛化设置中评估：跨基因面板和数据集的零样本迁移、留出患者和疾病状态，以及跨研究和组织来源的迁移。结合空间表达的统计模型，据我们所知，GESTALT还首次提供了细胞分辨的转录组场与组织图像的配对合成，并可显式控制细胞类型、密度和组成。代码可在 https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt 获取。

title: MedAstra: ASR-less Speech Retrieval with Diagnostic Grounding for Medical QA
zh_title: MedAstra：无需语音识别的医疗问答语音检索
summary: 预印本提出将冻结的WavLM语音表征经轻量适配器映射到E5文本嵌入空间，实现不经转录的语音检索。
key_points: 语音检索Recall@10达87.6，含文本路径达90.4
规避语音识别错误破坏临床关键术语
作者说明该语音嵌入非校准的声学不确定性模型
reason: 有新意的预印本方法并报告检索指标，但证据有限，未经同行评审
abstract: Spoken medical question answering can fail when automatic speech recognition (ASR) corrupts a clinically important term before retrieval. We present MedAstra, a framework that maps frozen WavLM speech representations through a lightweight adapter into a frozen E5 text embedding space. This enables a dense retrieval path that accepts a waveform without a query transcript. Retrieved passages and speech-linked textual metadata support answer generation with entity alternatives, diagnostic contrasts, relation heuristics, and bounded retrieval refinement. ASR-less refers to the initial speech retrieval interface; lexical retrieval, string-based entity correction, and the text generator require textual inputs. The deterministic speech embedding does not constitute a calibrated model of acoustic uncertainty. Reported retrieval results reach 87.6 Recall@10 for the speech-only retriever and 90.4 for the hybrid configuration, compared with 81.0 for transcript-first dense retrieval. Medical QA and ablations provide descriptive system comparisons, with input-provenance and evaluation limitations stated explicitly. We distinguish controlled synthetic acoustic tests from real clinical speech, qualify component attribution, and specify the remaining comparisons needed to assess speech-only QA and clinical generalization.
zh_abstract: 当自动语音识别（automatic speech recognition, ASR）在检索前破坏临床重要术语时，口语医学问答可能失败。我们提出MedAstra，这是一个框架，通过轻量适配器将冻结的WavLM语音表征映射到冻结的E5文本嵌入空间。这形成了一条稠密检索路径，可接受波形而无需查询转写。检索到的段落和与语音关联的文本元数据支持答案生成，并利用实体替代项、诊断对比、关系启发式和有界检索细化。无ASR指的是初始语音检索接口；词法检索、基于字符串的实体校正和文本生成器需要文本输入。确定性语音嵌入并不构成经过校准的声学不确定性模型。报告的检索结果达到：仅语音检索器Recall@10为87.6，混合配置为90.4，而转写优先的稠密检索为81.0。医学问答和消融实验提供了描述性系统比较，并明确说明了输入来源和评估局限性。我们将受控合成声学测试与真实临床语音区分开来，对组件归因加以限定，并明确了评估仅语音问答和临床泛化所需的其余比较。

title: A scoping review evaluating artificial intelligence applications across various injury prevention domains.
zh_title: AI在伤害预防各领域应用的范围综述
summary: 范围综述汇总自伤自杀、虐待暴力、跌倒与运动伤害预测中AI应用及预测性能。
key_points: 检索PubMed等五个数据库至2026年5月
仅纳入美国本土、有可测量预防结局的原研究
综合各伤害预防领域的AI应用与预测表现
reason: 范围综述、无新方法或新数据，属增量信息档
abstract: [Injury] Artificial intelligence (AI) has become increasingly utilized for injury prevention across diverse clinical and community settings including machine learning (ML). This scoping review aimed to synthesize the current literature on the applications and predictive performance of AI across multiple injury prevention domains. This scoping review searched five major databases, including PubMed, Embase, ScienceDirect, ProQuest, and the Cochrane Library, to identify studies evaluating AI applications for injury prevention published through May 2026. Eligible studies included original U.S.-based, English-language research across self-harm and suicide, abuse and violence, fall prevention, and sports injury prediction. Studies were excluded if they lacked measurable prevention outcomes or sufficient methodological detail, or focused on injury treatment rather than prevention, to ensure relevant and interpretable evidence for synthesis. Nineteen studies met the inclusion criteria. ML models generally outperformed or matched traditional screening methods for self-harm and suicide prediction (AUC 0.81-0.82), while multimodal approaches achieved the highest predictive accuracy (AUC 0.90). In abuse and violence prevention, AI predicted intimate partner violence with an AUC of 0.88 and identified cases before formal disclosure. AI also improved fall risk assessment by accurately categorizing patient risk levels, predicting future falls, and mitigating fall injuries through wearable airbag technology. ML models predicted future sports-related injuries (AUC 0.76-0.84), while identifying modifiable risk factors including workload, strength deficits, prior injury burden, and concussion history. ML-based prediction showed promise for risk stratification in self-harm, suicide, intimate partner violence, and recurrent victimization. Additionally, AI predicted fall risk and identified athletes at risk for future sports-related injuries while detecting modifiable risk factors, including workload, prior injury burden, and strength deficits. Although these findings suggest that AI and ML may have potential applications in supporting earlier risk identification, informing targeted prevention strategies, and facilitating more personalized approaches to injury prevention, the limited available evidence warrants careful interpretation.
zh_abstract: [《损伤》（Injury）] 人工智能（AI）已越来越多地用于不同临床和社区环境中的伤害预防，包括机器学习（ML）。本范围综述旨在综合当前关于AI在多个伤害预防领域中应用和预测性能的文献。本范围综述检索了五个主要数据库，包括PubMed、Embase、ScienceDirect、ProQuest和Cochrane Library，以识别截至2026年5月发表的评估AI用于伤害预防的研究。符合条件的研究包括原创的、基于美国的、英语研究，涵盖自伤和自杀、虐待和暴力、跌倒预防以及运动损伤预测。如果研究缺乏可测量的预防结局或足够的方法学细节，或侧重于伤害治疗而非预防，则被排除，以确保用于综合的证据相关且可解释。19项研究符合纳入标准。ML模型在自伤和自杀预测中通常优于或匹配传统筛查方法（AUC 0.81-0.82），而多模态方法达到最高预测准确度（AUC 0.90）。在虐待和暴力预防中，AI以0.88的AUC预测亲密伴侣暴力，并在正式披露前识别病例。AI还通过准确对患者风险水平分类、预测未来跌倒以及通过可穿戴安全气囊技术减轻跌倒伤害，改善了跌倒风险评估。ML模型预测未来运动相关损伤（AUC 0.76-0.84），同时识别可改变的风险因素，包括工作负荷、力量缺陷、既往损伤负担和脑震荡史。基于ML的预测在自伤、自杀、亲密伴侣暴力和反复受害的风险分层中显示出前景。此外，AI预测跌倒风险并识别有未来运动相关损伤风险的运动员，同时检测可改变的风险因素，包括工作负荷、既往损伤负担和力量缺陷。尽管这些发现表明AI和ML可能在支持更早识别风险、为有针对性的预防策略提供信息以及促进更个性化的伤害预防方法方面具有潜在应用，但现有证据有限，需要谨慎解读。

title: Conversational Interaction for LLM-Based Clinical Text-to-SQL: A User Study with Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 面向医护的对话式临床Text-to-SQL用户研究
summary: 14名常处理电子病历数据的医生在MIMIC-IV上对比单轮与多轮对话式Text-to-SQL界面，对话式可用性评分显著更高。
key_points: 14名医生被试内设计，另分析21名医护交互日志
系统可用性量表均值由68.2升至85.9（p<0.001）
技术接受度各维度均偏好对话式界面
reason: 真实医护用户研究、设计规范但样本小且为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Conversational text-to-SQL interfaces could give healthcare professionals natural-language access to electronic health record (EHR) data, but evidence for their real-world usability remains limited: prior evaluations have relied largely on curated benchmarks with fully specified questions or on simulated users. We report a user study in which 14 physicians who regularly work with EHR data used both a single-turn and a conversational multi-turn text-to-SQL interface over the MIMIC-IV database in a within-subjects design; dialogue analyses additionally drew on interaction logs from 21 healthcare professionals across the main study and two pilot studies. The conversational interface was consistently favored: mean System Usability Scale scores rose from 68.2, near the industry average, to 85.9 (p<0.001), with significant advantages across technology-acceptance constructs including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention. In post-study forced-choice comparisons, 93% of participants reported greater overall satisfaction with the conversational interface, 86% preferred it for real-world adoption, and 71% trusted its results more; no participant preferred or trusted the single-turn interface more. Turn-level analysis of 425 logged user turns showed that freely composed queries triggered clarification requests in 24.8% of cases versus 1.8% for predefined, fully specified questions, and 64.3% of clarification episodes stemmed from EHR- or clinical-domain knowledge. Conversational interaction is a practical prerequisite, rather than a convenience, for natural-language EHR access. The frequent need for clarification in realistic clinical queries further underscores the importance of conversational interfaces, while benchmark-style evaluation can substantially underrepresent the ambiguity of real clinical use.
zh_abstract: 对话式文本到SQL接口可以为医疗保健专业人员提供对电子健康记录（EHR）数据的自然语言访问，但其真实世界可用性的证据仍然有限：既往评估主要依赖问题完全明确的精选基准或模拟用户。我们报告了一项用户研究：14名经常处理EHR数据的医生在被试内设计中，通过MIMIC-IV数据库同时使用单轮和对话式多轮文本到SQL接口；对话分析还利用了来自主研究和两项试点研究的21名医疗保健专业人员的交互日志。对话式接口始终更受青睐：系统可用性量表平均得分从接近行业平均水平的68.2升至85.9（p<0.001），并在绩效期望、努力期望、自我效能和行为意向等技术接受度构念上均具有显著优势。在研究后强制选择比较中，93%的参与者报告对对话式接口的总体满意度更高，86%的参与者更倾向于在真实世界采用它，71%的参与者更信任其结果；没有参与者更偏好或更信任单轮接口。对425个记录的用户轮次进行的轮次级分析显示，自由组构的查询在24.8%的情况下触发澄清请求，而预定义、完全明确的问题为1.8%；64.3%的澄清事件源于EHR或临床领域知识。对话式交互是实现自然语言EHR访问的实际前提，而非一种便利性功能。真实临床查询中频繁需要澄清，进一步凸显了对话式接口的重要性；而基准式评估可能大幅低估真实临床使用中的模糊性。

title: ECG2Gene: Deep Learning-Based Germline Tumor Susceptibility Gene Risk Assessment Using Electrocardiograms
zh_title: ECG2Gene：用心电图深度学习评估胚系肿瘤易感基因风险
summary: 预印本提出两阶段框架，从常规 12 导联心电图推导六个基因评分并结合临床变量预测未来癌症风险。
key_points: 第一阶段以 ATM、BRCA1/2 等六基因致病携带状态监督多任务模型
第二阶段用 XGBoost 融合评分与临床变量预测乳腺、卵巢和前列腺癌
提出 EWAS 分析心电图衍生基因评分与波形之间的关联
reason: 思路新颖的预印本方法，验证范围与外部验证情况未明，属值得一看档
abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) may contain physiological information related to hereditary cancer susceptibility, but its relationship with future cancer risk remains unclear. Here, we present ECG2Gene, a two-stage deep-learning framework that derives digital phenotypes related to germline tumor susceptibility from routine 12-lead ECGs and predicts future cancer risk. In Stage 1, carrier status for pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in ATM, BRIP1, CHEK2, PALB2, BRCA1, and BRCA2 supervises a multitask model that generates six continuous ECG-derived gene scores. In Stage 2, XGBoost integrates these scores with clinical variables to predict subsequent breast and ovarian cancer in women and prostate cancer in men. We also introduce ECG-Wide Association Analysis (EWAS) to characterize associations between ECG-derived gene scores and ECG waveforms. Across the clinical feature combinations evaluated in UK Biobank, the best-performing sex-specific models achieve AUROCs of 0.683, 0.633, and 0.660 for breast, ovarian, and prostate cancer, respectively. In external evaluations, models combining ECG-derived gene scores with age achieve prostate cancer AUROCs of 0.709 and 0.579 among men in the overall China Kadoorie Biobank and MIMIC-IV-ECG cohorts, respectively. ECG2Gene links genetically supervised ECG phenotyping and waveform association analysis to future cancer outcomes, demonstrating the potential of routine ECGs combined with clinical information for non-invasive, opportunistic cancer risk assessment.
zh_abstract: 心电图（electrocardiograms, ECGs）可能包含与遗传性癌症易感性相关的生理信息，但其与未来癌症风险的关系仍不清楚。在此，我们提出 ECG2Gene，一种两阶段深度学习框架，从常规 12 导联 ECG 中提取与胚系肿瘤易感性相关的数字表型，并预测未来癌症风险。在第一阶段，ATM、BRIP1、CHEK2、PALB2、BRCA1 和 BRCA2 中致病或可能致病变异的携带者状态监督一个多任务模型，该模型生成六个连续的 ECG 衍生基因评分。在第二阶段，XGBoost 将这些评分与临床变量整合，以预测女性后续乳腺癌和卵巢癌以及男性前列腺癌。我们还引入 ECG 全关联分析（ECG-Wide Association Analysis, EWAS），以刻画 ECG 衍生基因评分与 ECG 波形之间的关联。在英国生物银行（UK Biobank）评估的临床特征组合中，表现最佳的性别特异性模型对乳腺癌、卵巢癌和前列腺癌分别达到 AUROC 0.683、0.633 和 0.660。在外部评估中，将 ECG 衍生基因评分与年龄结合的模型在中国慢性病前瞻性研究（China Kadoorie Biobank）总体队列和 MIMIC-IV-ECG 队列的男性中，分别达到前列腺癌 AUROC 0.709 和 0.579。ECG2Gene 将遗传学监督的 ECG 表型分析和波形关联分析与未来癌症结局联系起来，证明常规 ECG 结合临床信息用于无创、机会性癌症风险评估的潜力。

title: Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models
zh_title: Tetun语医学问答数据集Labadain-MedQA
summary: 用Gemini 2.5 Flash将MedAlpaca资料译为Tetun语，构建39,077条医学问答对并评估翻译质量。
key_points: 共生成39,077条Tetun语医学问答对
抽样50组问答做自动指标与人工评估
两位母语医护评分：人工译文4.43/5高于LLM的4.02/5
reason: 低资源语言医学QA数据集，含人工评估但规模验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. Human translations achieved higher mean ratings than LLM-generated translations for both criteria (4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5), with statistically significant differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.001). To assess downstream utility, we fine-tuned Gemma and Llama variants on the translated MedAlpaca dataset using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and evaluated them on 325 Tetun-translated United States Medical Licensing Examination multiple-choice questions. Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned using QLoRA achieved relative improvements in mean accuracy of 10.79% with 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) inference and 10.42% after merging the LoRA adapters into the BF16 base model, compared with the corresponding base models. These results highlight the viability of automatic dataset translation for Tetun medical QA and the effectiveness of PEFT in enhancing model performance. The datasets, models, and evaluation resources are accessible at https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa to support reproducible research on Tetun medical QA and facilitate machine translation, cross lingual, and multilingual research.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的进步为将医学知识从高资源语言跨语言迁移到低资源语言、以支持获取医疗信息创造了机会。然而，用于微调和评估 LLMs 的 Tetun 医学问答（QA）数据集仍然稀缺。为填补这一空白，我们使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 将 MedAlpaca 的 Medical Flashcards 和 WikiDoc Patient Information 集合翻译成 Tetun，产生了 39,077 个医学 QA 对。翻译质量在 50 个随机抽样的 QA 对（100 份文档）上评估，使用自动指标与人工参考译文进行比较，并由两名母语为 Tetun 的医疗专业人员评估，重点关注医学准确性和 Tetun 流利度。在两项标准上，人工翻译的平均评分均高于 LLM 生成的翻译（4.43/5 对 4.02/5），差异具有统计学显著性（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，p < 0.001）。为评估下游效用，我们使用参数高效微调（PEFT）在翻译后的 MedAlpaca 数据集上微调 Gemma 和 Llama 变体，并在 325 道翻译成 Tetun 的美国医师执照考试（United States Medical Licensing Examination）多项选择题上评估它们。使用 QLoRA 微调的 Gemma 4 12B 在 4 位 NormalFloat（NF4）推理下平均准确率相对提高 10.79%，在将 LoRA 适配器合并到 BF16 基础模型后相对提高 10.42%，与相应的基础模型相比。这些结果凸显了自动数据集翻译用于 Tetun 医学 QA 的可行性，以及 PEFT 在提升模型性能方面的有效性。数据集、模型和评估资源可在 https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa 获取，以支持 Tetun 医学 QA 的可重复研究，并促进机器翻译、跨语言和多语言研究。

title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
zh_title: CheXPoT：放射报告视觉核验与修正
summary: 提出程序化思维框架，将生成报告拆为谓词并用影像证据核验，删除无法落地的发现后重写报告。
key_points: 用RadGraph与LLM将报告拆为谓词
以DenseNet-121与Grad-CAM构建视觉证据表
删除无影像依据的发现后重写报告
reason: 预印本新方法针对报告幻觉，缺外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.
zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在胸部 X 线片报告生成方面显示出前景，但由于存在未基于图像的幻觉发现，其采用仍然有限。纠正这些幻觉并提高整体报告质量仍然是一项重大挑战。先前工作通过强化学习、偏好优化或思维链监督来精炼模型以解决这一问题，通常计算成本很高。为填补这一空白，我们引入 CheXPoT，一种程序化思维（program-of-thought, PoT）框架，它根据图像特征验证每个生成的发现，并移除无法基于图像证据的发现。CheXPoT 使用 RadGraph 和 LLM 将生成的报告分解为谓词，将这些谓词与 DenseNet-121 和 Grad-CAM 视觉证据表进行 grounding，执行 PoT 验证代码，并在移除不支持的谓词后重写报告。在 4,145 张图像的留出拆分上，CheXPoT 在 14 个 CheXpert 类别中的 8 个上取得统计学显著的精确率提升，在 5 个上取得 F1 提升，且两项指标均无显著下降。CheXPoT 将微平均精确率从 19.2%（MedGemma-4B）提升至 46.8%（MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT），将微平均 F1 从 23.0% 提升至 49.4%，绝对增益分别为 27.6% 和 26.4%。我们还在其他 VLM 报告生成器上测试了 CheXPoT。在 LLaVA-Med 上，CheXPoT 将微平均精确率从 4.5% 提升至 17.7%，将微平均 F1 从 6.3% 提升至 19.4%。在 MAIRA-2 上，CheXPoT 将微平均精确率从 15.6% 提升至 42.1%，将微平均 F1 从 21.0% 提升至 45.3%。我们的结果表明，廉价的即席视觉验证可能通过纠正生成报告中不支持的发现来提高 VLM 的可信度。CheXPoT 为帮助验证 VLM 生成的放射学报告并减少不支持发现的工具奠定了基础。这些创新随后可能有助于提高 VLM 工具在医学中的信任度和采用率。

title: HALO: Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records
zh_title: HALO：纵向病历中预算受限的标签优化分配
summary: 预印本提出分层证据选择结合强化学习，在有限标注预算下决定读取哪些病历与获取何种保真度标签。
key_points: 联合优化证据选择与标签来源分配
标签分免费、银级、金级三档保真度
针对重复就诊与异构记录的纵向临床数据
reason: 方法有新意，针对标注预算的实际问题，但仅预印本、证据有限
abstract: Learning from extensive longitudinal clinical records--spanning repeated encounters, evolving conditions, and heterogeneous documentation--under a finite labeling budget requires solving two coupled problems: deciding what evidence to keep and deciding which patients deserve higher-fidelity labels. Prior work on active learning and multi-fidelity label acquisition mainly addresses the second problem, while treating the evidence presented to the acquisition policy as fixed. We present HALO, a Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records. This framework jointly learns what to read and what label source to acquire under budget. HALO first selects informative evidence from longitudinal records and then uses a budget-aware policy to allocate free-, silver-, and gold-fidelity label sources. For frozen policies, our theory characterizes asymmetric acquired-label channels and gives a budget-constrained finite-sample gold-risk bound for a common downstream logistic model. In a heart-failure case study, HALO attained the highest MedAlign acquired-label F1 at six of eight target budgets. A downstream classifier trained on HALO-acquired labels attained the highest external MGB F1 at budgets 15-60 and remained within 0.01 of the best comparator at budgets 75-120.
zh_abstract: 在有限标注预算下，从广泛的纵向临床记录中学习——这些记录涵盖反复就诊、不断变化的病情和异质性文档——需要解决两个耦合问题：决定保留哪些证据，以及决定哪些患者应获得更高保真度的标签。以往关于主动学习和多保真度标签获取的工作主要解决第二个问题，同时将呈现给获取策略的证据视为固定。我们提出HALO，这是一种用于从纵向临床记录中分配预算化标签优化的分层证据选择与强化学习流程（Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records）。该框架联合学习在预算下读什么以及获取何种标签来源。HALO首先从纵向记录中选择信息量大的证据，然后使用预算感知策略来分配免费、银级和金级保真度标签来源。对于冻结策略，我们的理论刻画了非对称的已获取标签通道，并为常见的下游逻辑回归模型给出了预算约束的有限样本金标准风险界。在一项心力衰竭案例研究中，HALO在8个目标预算中的6个取得了最高的MedAlign已获取标签F1。在HALO获取的标签上训练的下游分类器在预算15-60时取得了最高的外部MGB F1，并在预算75-120时与最佳比较方法的差距保持在0.01以内。

title: Density-Aware Calibration for Resource-Efficient Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 面向资源受限场景的医学视觉语言模型密度感知校准
summary: 预印本提出免训练校准集构建框架CoreCalib，提升医学视觉问答模型训练后量化的效果。
key_points: 按临床问题类别分层并聚类代表性视觉模式
在Kvasir-VQA-x1上固定128对校准预算
三种量化器下均取得最佳METEOR
reason: 预印本方法有基线对比，但仅单一数据集验证，证据有限
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show promise for clinical image understanding, but their computational and memory requirements hinder deployment on resource-constrained clinical hardware. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical compression strategy without retraining, yet its effectiveness depends strongly on the calibration data. We propose CoreCalib, a training-free and quantizer-agnostic framework for constructing compact calibration sets that preserve the target medical VQA distribution. CoreCalib stratifies data by clinical question class, identifies representative visual modes using frozen DINOv2 features with UMAP and HDBSCAN, and expands selected images into class-balanced question-answer pairs. On Kvasir-VQA-x1, we evaluate CoreCalib with MASQuant, GPTQ, and QIG using a fixed 128-pair budget. CoreCalib achieves the best METEOR with all three quantizers and the best ROUGE-L with MASQuant and GPTQ. With W4A8 MASQuant, it improves METEOR from 0.5672 with COCO calibration to 0.6234, recovering approximately 41% of the degradation relative to BF16. These results support CoreCalib as a data-centric component for resource-efficient medical VLM deployment. Project page: https://magnusdtd.github.io/CoreCalib/ .
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在临床图像理解方面显示出前景，但其计算和内存需求阻碍了在资源受限的临床硬件上部署。训练后量化（PTQ）提供了一种无需重新训练的实际压缩策略，但其有效性强烈依赖于校准数据。我们提出CoreCalib，一个免训练且与量化器无关的框架，用于构建保留目标医学VQA分布的紧凑校准集。CoreCalib按临床问题类别对数据分层，使用冻结的DINOv2特征结合UMAP和HDBSCAN识别代表性视觉模式，并将所选图像扩展为类别平衡的问答对。在Kvasir-VQA-x1上，我们使用固定的128对预算，以MASQuant、GPTQ和QIG评估CoreCalib。CoreCalib在三种量化器下均取得最佳METEOR，并在MASQuant和GPTQ下取得最佳ROUGE-L。使用W4A8 MASQuant时，它将METEOR从COCO校准的0.5672提高到0.6234，相对于BF16恢复了约41%的退化。这些结果支持CoreCalib作为面向资源高效医学VLM部署的以数据为中心的组件。项目页面：https://magnusdtd.github.io/CoreCalib/ 。

title: Where Does EEG Help Wearable Freezing of Gait Detection?
zh_title: EEG 在可穿戴冻结步态检测中的作用
summary: 利用 5 个数据集的同步 EEG-IMU 记录做预训练，探索部署时仅用 IMU 能否保留 EEG 带来的增益。
key_points: 预训练语料含 5 个数据集、184 人、94 小时
对比六种预训练与输入模态组合设置
BXHC 数据集采用留一患者交叉验证，仅 10 例患者
reason: 可穿戴多模态预训练有新意，但评估队列小，属值得一看档
abstract: Freezing of gait (FoG) detectors built on inertial measurement units (IMUs) are accurate while the legs move, but they become unreliable when the legs are nearly still, which is exactly when akinetic freezing, voluntary stopping, and standing must be told apart. Electroencephalography (EEG) captures motor-planning activity that leg sensors cannot, but EEG is impractical for daily use. We ask where EEG helps: as an input at inference time, or only during pretraining, so that the deployed detector still needs only IMUs. We assemble a pretraining corpus of synchronized EEG and IMU recordings (5 datasets, 184 people, 94 hours) and compare six settings that differ only in the modalities used for pretraining and as model input, each with tuned hyperparameters and five independent pretraining runs. On the BXHC FoG dataset (leave-one-patient-out, 10 patients with FoG), adding EEG as input raises FoG F1 from 0.663 to 0.740 (9 of 10 patients improve), and the gain in ranking performance is confined to the quartile of windows with the least leg movement (AUROC +0.063). Pretraining the IMU encoder jointly with EEG improves an IMU-only detector both within the cohort (FoG F1 0.663 to 0.705) and when it is trained on a small cohort and tested on another (FoG F1 +0.083, all 10 test patients improve). Repeating the study with PD-only and healthy-only pretraining corpora, each with its own hyperparameter search, shows that IMU-based detection is robust to the corpus, whereas the benefit of aligning EEG with IMU requires both. Cross-cohort analysis further shows that detectors trained without annotated voluntary stops classify nearly all stops as freezing. Finally, on PD versus non-PD classification in three external datasets, joint EEG+IMU pretraining improves PD detection from walking EEG over EEG-only pretraining (AUROC 0.750 vs. 0.683), while IMU-based detection does not depend on the pretraining.
zh_abstract: 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的冻结步态（FoG）检测器在腿部运动时是准确的，但当腿部几乎静止时会变得不可靠，而这正是必须区分无动性冻结、自主停止和站立的时候。脑电图（EEG）可捕捉腿部传感器无法捕捉的运动规划活动，但EEG在日常使用中不切实际。我们探究EEG在何处有帮助：是在推理时作为输入，还是仅在预训练期间使用，从而使部署的检测器仍然只需要IMU。我们构建了一个由同步EEG和IMU记录组成的预训练语料库（5个数据集、184人、94小时），并比较了六种设置，这些设置仅在用于预训练和作为模型输入的模式上不同，每种设置都进行超参数调优并有五次独立预训练运行。在BXHC FoG数据集上（留一患者交叉验证，10名FoG患者），将EEG作为输入使FoG F1从0.663提高到0.740（10名患者中有9名改善），并且排序性能的提升仅限于腿部运动最少的四分位窗口（AUROC +0.063）。将IMU编码器与EEG联合预训练可在队列内改善仅使用IMU的检测器（FoG F1从0.663提高到0.705），并且当它在一个小队列上训练并在另一个队列上测试时也有改善（FoG F1 +0.083，全部10名测试患者均改善）。使用仅PD和仅健康者的预训练语料库重复研究，且各自进行超参数搜索，结果表明基于IMU的检测对语料库稳健，而将EEG与IMU对齐的获益需要两者都存在。跨队列分析进一步表明，未经标注的自主停止训练的检测器将几乎所有停止分类为冻结。最后，在三个外部数据集上的PD与非PD分类中，联合EEG+IMU预训练相较于仅EEG预训练，提高了基于行走EEG的PD检测（AUROC 0.750 vs. 0.683），而基于IMU的检测不依赖于预训练。

title: From WSIs to Bulk, Spatial and Single-Cell Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Graph Neural Networks
zh_title: 多尺度图神经网络从全切片图像预测批量、空间与单细胞转录组
summary: 预印本提出多尺度图神经网络，用病理基础模型提取特征，从全切片图像同时预测批量、空间与单细胞转录组。
key_points: 基于 UNI2-h 病理基础模型提取形态特征
构建 patch 与细胞两级空间图学习层级关系
在 TCGA、Visium、Xenium 肺肾乳腺样本上训练
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，多队列训练但未说明外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of gene expression is key to studying complex diseases like cancer. While Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) and Single-Cell Transcriptomics (scT) provide high-resolution insights, they remain expensive and scarce. In contrast, standard histopathology Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) paired with bulk RNA sequencing are widely available. This work introduces a Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network (GNN) capable of simultaneously predicting bulk, spatial, and single-cell transcriptomics directly from WSIs. By extracting morphological features using a Pathology Foundation Model (PFM) (UNI2-h) and constructing spatial graphs at both patch and cell levels, the model learns the hierarchical relationships within the tissue. The network is trained on a combined dataset of The Cancer Genome Atlas Program (TCGA), Visium, and Xenium samples across lung, kidney, and breast tissues. A hybrid training strategy is employed, leveraging direct supervision alongside weakly supervised consistency losses to ensure predictions align across biological scales. Results show the model accurately predicts gene expression at the slide level and moderately at the patch level (strongest on Xenium), and achieves moderate correlation at the challenging single-cell level. Furthermore, downstream tasks explore the clinical relevance of these predictions, demonstrating their utility in survival analysis, spatial hazard mapping, and tumor classification via molecular signatures.
zh_abstract: 理解基因表达的空间分布是研究癌症等复杂疾病的关键。空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）与单细胞转录组学（Single-Cell Transcriptomics, scT）虽能提供高分辨率见解，但成本高昂且样本稀缺。相比之下，标准组织病理学全切片图像（Whole-Slide Images, WSIs）结合批量 RNA 测序的数据则广泛可得。本工作提出一种多尺度图神经网络（Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network, GNN），能够直接从 WSIs 同时预测批量、空间和单细胞转录组。该模型利用病理基础模型（Pathology Foundation Model, PFM）（UNI2-h）提取形态学特征，并在斑块（patch）和细胞两个层面构建空间图，从而学习组织内的层级关系。该网络在涵盖肺、肾和乳腺组织的癌症基因组图谱计划（The Cancer Genome Atlas Program, TCGA）、Visium 和 Xenium 样本的合并数据集上训练。研究采用混合训练策略，将直接监督与弱监督一致性损失相结合，以确保预测在多个生物学尺度上保持一致。结果表明，该模型在切片水平上能准确预测基因表达，在斑块水平上表现中等（在 Xenium 上最强），并在具有挑战性的单细胞水平上达到中等相关性。此外，下游任务探索了这些预测的临床相关性，证明了其在生存分析、空间风险图绘制以及通过分子特征进行肿瘤分类方面的实用性。

title: Toward Contrast-Free Breast MRI: Improving Cancer Detection With Virtual Contrast Enhanced Imaging
zh_title: 虚拟增强乳腺MRI提升无对比剂癌症检测
summary: 预印本研究构建结合无对比与虚拟增强MRI的检测框架，测试集AUROC由0.865升至0.901。
key_points: 无对比剂MRI单用AUROC 0.865
结合虚拟增强后升至0.901
模拟患者分流以替代部分真实增强扫描
reason: 仅内部测试集回顾性评估，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Although contrast-enhanced (CE) breast MRI is an important tool for cancer detection, intravenous gadolinium administration introduces additional considerations for patients and clinical workflows. AI based virtual contrast enhanced (VCE) MRI could help identify patients for whom acquired CE imaging may be avoidable without compromising diagnostic performance. We developed a framework that combines non contrast (NC) and VCE MRI predictions for cancer detection. On the held-out test set, cancer detection using NC MRI alone achieved an AUROC of 0.865. Combining the predictions from NC and VCE MRI improved AUROC to 0.901. Building on this complementary predictive value, we evaluated patient-level routing to progressively replace acquired CE examinations with the NC plus VCE pathway, prioritizing patients with the most confident NC predictions. This simulation suggests that diagnostic performance can be largely preserved while limiting acquired CE imaging to approximately 40% of patients. Together, these findings demonstrate the complementary value of VCE MRI and suggest its potential to support selective contrast use in breast cancer screening.
zh_abstract: 尽管对比增强（CE）乳腺 MRI 是癌症检测的重要工具，但静脉注射钆剂会给患者和临床工作流程带来额外考量。基于 AI 的虚拟对比增强（VCE）MRI 可能有助于识别哪些患者可以在不损害诊断性能的情况下避免采集 CE 成像。我们开发了一个将非对比（NC）和 VCE MRI 预测相结合用于癌症检测的框架。在留出测试集上，仅使用 NC MRI 进行癌症检测达到 AUROC 0.865。结合 NC 和 VCE MRI 的预测将 AUROC 提高到 0.901。基于这种互补预测价值，我们评估了患者层面的路由，以逐步用 NC 加 VCE 路径替代采集的 CE 检查，优先选择 NC 预测最有信心的患者。这一模拟提示，诊断性能可以在很大程度上得以保留，同时将采集的 CE 成像限制在约 40% 的患者中。总之，这些发现证明了 VCE MRI 的互补价值，并提示其支持乳腺癌筛查中选择性使用对比剂的潜力。

title: Advancing Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Domain-Specific Large Language Models
zh_title: 领域专用大模型预测临床试验结局
summary: 在TOP基准12477项试验上比较BioBERT与BioMistral的微调与探针式预测效果。
key_points: 以ClinicalTrials.gov十个字段构建试验文本
对比全量微调、LoRA与冻结探针三种方案
按分期在留出测试集上评估结局预测
reason: 预印本，有公开基准与基线对比，但证据限于回顾性预测任务
abstract: Clinical trial failures are a major barrier to efficient drug development, incurring substantial costs and delaying patient access to effective therapies. Structured approaches such as the Hierarchical Interaction Network (HINT) predict trial outcomes by explicitly modelling interactions between drugs, diseases and protocols, but make limited use of the free text in trial registrations. We evaluate two domain-specific language models, BioBERT (108M parameters) and BioMistral (7B parameters), for phase-level outcome prediction on the TOP benchmark (12,477 trials), representing each trial as text built from ten ClinicalTrials.gov fields. We compare fine-tuning (full fine-tuning for BioBERT, low-rank adaptation for BioMistral) with probing, in which the pretrained model is frozen and only a lightweight classifier is trained on its embeddings. On the held-out test set of each phase, all four language-model variants achieved higher ROC-AUC (0.613--0.772) and PR-AUC (0.649--0.901) than the published HINT results, corresponding to relative PR-AUC gains of 10--20\%. F1 differences were small and mixed, and no model, including HINT, clearly exceeded the F1 of a trivial classifier that predicts success for every trial. Under the configurations tested, probing performed comparably to fine-tuning: fine-tuned models scored highest on ROC-AUC and PR-AUC in Phases I and II, and frozen BioMistral embeddings in Phase III (ROC-AUC 0.772; PR-AUC 0.901), although most differences between variants were below 0.03 and were not tested for significance. These results suggest that pretrained biomedical representations already encode signal relevant to trial outcome, and that probing is a computationally cheaper alternative to fine-tuning for this task.
zh_abstract: 临床试验失败是高效药物开发的主要障碍，会造成巨大成本并延迟患者获得有效治疗。Hierarchical Interaction Network（HINT）等结构化方法通过显式建模药物、疾病和方案之间的交互来预测试验结局，但对试验注册信息中的自由文本利用有限。我们在TOP基准（12,477项试验）上评估两个领域特定语言模型BioBERT（108M参数）和BioMistral（7B参数）用于阶段层面结局预测，将每项试验表示为基于ClinicalTrials.gov十个字段构建的文本。我们比较微调（BioBERT采用全参数微调，BioMistral采用低秩适应）与探测（probing），后者冻结预训练模型，仅在其嵌入上训练轻量级分类器。在每个阶段的留出测试集上，全部四个语言模型变体均取得高于已发表HINT结果的ROC-AUC（0.613–0.772）和PR-AUC（0.649–0.901），对应PR-AUC相对提升10%–20%。F1差异较小且方向不一，且没有模型（包括HINT）明显超过对每项试验都预测成功的简单分类器的F1。在所测试的配置下，探测的表现与微调相当：微调模型在I期和II期的ROC-AUC和PR-AUC最高，冻结BioMistral嵌入在III期最高（ROC-AUC 0.772；PR-AUC 0.901），尽管变体之间大多数差异低于0.03且未进行显著性检验。这些结果表明，预训练生物医学表示已编码与试验结局相关的信号，并且对于该任务，探测是计算成本低于微调的替代方案。

title: PsyInterviewee: Informational Invariance and Relational Adaptivity in Mental Health Interview Simulation
zh_title: 心理健康访谈模拟中的信息不变性
summary: 提出PsyInterviewee，将受保护的临床事实通道与动态互动通道分离以提升模拟可靠性。
key_points: 分离受保护事实通道与动态互动通道
非对称写权限禁止对话新增临床事实
生成临床陈述与画像逐条核验
reason: 预印本，方法有新意但缺乏规模化的外部验证与临床结局证据
abstract: LLM-based simulated interviewees support interviewer training and the evaluation of mental health interviewing systems. Existing studies have primarily focused on improving human-likeness through richer patient profiles and behavioral modeling. However, human-likeness alone does not establish their reliability. Reliable simulation requires preserving profile-grounded clinical facts (informational invariance) while adapting disclosure and interaction behavior to the interview (relational adaptivity). To this end, we introduce PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel and verifies generated clinical claims against the profile. Specifically, asymmetric write permissions allow dialogue context to update disclosure and behavioral states without authorizing new clinical facts; these states guide what profile-supported information is revealed and how it is expressed. In an automated evaluation of interactions between LLM-based interviewers and interviewees, PsyInterviewee achieves higher scores than four representative baselines on most metrics across both axes, as assessed by two LLM judges. Ablations suggest that the two channels contribute to clinical grounding and response modulation, respectively.
zh_abstract: 基于LLM的模拟受访者可支持访谈者培训和精神健康访谈系统评估。现有研究主要聚焦于通过更丰富的患者画像和行为建模提高拟人性。然而，仅凭拟人性并不能确立其可靠性。可靠的模拟需要在使披露和交互行为适应访谈（关系适应性）的同时，保留以画像为依据的临床事实（信息不变性）。为此，我们引入PsyInterviewee，它将受保护的真实性通道与动态交互通道分离，并根据画像验证生成的临床陈述。具体而言，非对称写权限允许对话上下文更新披露状态和行为状态，但不授权新的临床事实；这些状态指导披露哪些由画像支持的信息以及如何表达。在对基于LLM的访谈者与受访者之间交互的自动化评估中，由两名LLM评判者评估，PsyInterviewee在两个轴的大多数指标上均取得高于四个代表性基线的分数。消融实验表明，这两个通道分别有助于临床根基和反应调节。

title: VariaFlow: Uncertainty-Aware Flow Matching for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
zh_title: VariaFlow：不确定性感知的无监督异常检测
summary: VariaFlow用掩码引导恢复集成估计每个位置的预测方差，以区分真实病变与健康解剖变异，降低重建残差误报。
key_points: 指出重建残差同时含病变与正常解剖变异两种来源
在无条件流匹配先验下由不同噪声初始化的集成估计方差
目标是减少健康解剖变异处的假阳性并保留细微病灶
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，临床验证信息有限
abstract: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection no longer fails at reconstruction. Generative models produce high-quality pseudo-healthy reconstructions, and the remaining difficulty is the step of scoring residuals. The residual between a scan and its reconstruction has two indistinguishable sources, genuine pathology and the anatomical variation that separates one healthy brain from another. Scoring against a single reconstruction treats both as anomalous, inflating false positives where healthy anatomy varies most while small or subtle lesions are lost in the surrounding reconstruction error. We identify the missing quantity as the predictive variance, how much a healthy reconstruction can vary at each location. We introduce VariaFlow, which estimates this variance from an ensemble of mask-guided restorations under an unconditional flow matching prior, each started from a different noise initialization, and which normalizes the residual by the resulting standard deviation. Few-step flow matching keeps the ensemble computationally affordable, and restoring at two spatial scales captures lesions of different size. Across three brain MRI datasets spanning stroke and tumor, VariaFlow is trained once on healthy anatomy and generalizes across all three, attaining the highest AUROC (0.94, 0.80, 0.78) on each and the highest AUPRC on both cross-domain datasets, exceeding the strongest baseline by 37% and 50%. Under domain shift, the same baseline drops by up to 52% in AUPRC, whereas VariaFlow stays more stable and achieves the best small-lesion Dice on all three datasets.
zh_abstract: 基于重建的异常检测不再在重建环节失败。生成模型产生高质量伪健康重建，剩下的困难是残差评分步骤。扫描与其重建之间的残差有两个无法区分的来源：真实病理和将一个健康大脑与另一个健康大脑区分开的解剖变异。针对单一重建进行评分会将二者均视为异常，在健康解剖变异最大处抬高假阳性，而小或细微病灶则在周围重建误差中丢失。我们将缺失量确定为预测方差，即健康重建在每个位置可以变化多少。我们引入 VariaFlow，它在无条件流匹配（flow matching）先验下，从一组掩码引导恢复的集成中估计该方差，每个恢复从不同的噪声初始化开始，并用所得标准差对残差进行归一化。少步流匹配使该集成在计算上可负担，并在两个空间尺度上进行恢复可捕获不同大小的病灶。在涵盖卒中和肿瘤的三个脑 MRI 数据集上，VariaFlow 仅在健康解剖上训练一次，并泛化到所有三个数据集，在每个数据集上达到最高 AUROC（0.94、0.80、0.78），并在两个跨域数据集上达到最高 AUPRC，超过最强基线 37% 和 50%。在域偏移下，同一基线在 AUPRC 上下降最多 52%，而 VariaFlow 保持更稳定，并在所有三个数据集上取得最佳小病灶 Dice。

title: Measuring What Matters: A Causal Reliance Score for Histopathology Image Segmentation
zh_title: 病理分割的因果依赖评分
summary: 提出因果依赖评分（CRS），通过受控干预量化病理分割模型对前景组织与背景域变化的相对敏感性。
key_points: 以受控干预构建因果式评估框架
CRS量化前景扰动与背景变化的敏感性
设计增强策略作为隐式反事实干预
reason: 评估方法有新意，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Reliable histopathology segmentation requires models that rely on pathology-relevant structures rather than spurious background correlations. In this work, we argue that improving architectures alone is insufficient if models continue to rely on spurious correlations rather than pathology-relevant features. We introduce a causality-inspired evaluation framework based on controlled interventions that explicitly probes model sensitivity to foreground tissue structure and background/domain variation. Building on this, we propose the Causal Reliance Score (CRS), a metric that quantifies the relative sensitivity of model predictions to foreground perturbation versus background/domain variation under controlled interventions. To support this analysis, we design augmentation strategies that act as implicit counterfactual interventions during training, encouraging invariance to nuisance factors while preserving morphology. We demonstrate how these interventions reveal behavioural differences between models that are not captured by standard metrics such as Dice or IoU. While we instantiate our framework using a self-supervised transformer (CAUSE-ViT), the primary contribution of this work is not a new architecture, but a principled intervention-based methodology and evaluation metric for auditing model behaviour in medical image segmentation. Our results suggest that evaluating model behaviour through counterfactual interventions is essential for developing reliable and clinically robust medical image segmentation systems.
zh_abstract: 可靠的组织病理学分割需要模型依赖病理相关结构，而非虚假的背景相关性。在本工作中，我们认为，如果模型仍依赖虚假相关性而非病理相关特征，仅改进架构是不够的。我们引入了一个受因果性启发的评估框架，基于受控干预，明确探查模型对前景组织结构与背景/域变化的敏感性。在此基础上，我们提出因果依赖分数（Causal Reliance Score，CRS），该指标在受控干预下量化模型预测对前景扰动相对于背景/域变化的相对敏感性。为支持这一分析，我们设计了在训练期间充当隐式反事实干预的增强策略，鼓励对 nuisance 因素的不变性，同时保留形态学。我们展示了这些干预如何揭示 Dice 或 IoU 等标准指标未能捕获的模型间行为差异。尽管我们使用自监督 Transformer（CAUSE-ViT）实例化了该框架，本工作的主要贡献并非新架构，而是一种有原则的、基于干预的方法学和评估指标，用于审计医学图像分割中的模型行为。我们的结果表明，通过反事实干预评估模型行为对于开发可靠且临床稳健的医学图像分割系统至关重要。

title: Different Models, Shared Failures: Auditing Frozen-Encoder Pools for Medical Segmentation
zh_title: 医学分割预训练编码器池的共失败审计
summary: 预印本CoFailMed在五个2D分割任务上评估11至17个公开预训练编码器，发现同家族检查点失败高度相关，跨编码器模型池的有效规模远低于成员数。
key_points: 同源检查点逐例Dice相关性最高
跨家族配对相关性低于同家族配对
四成员异构池有效规模仅约1.56–2.92
reason: 提供模型集成失败相关性的实证审计，样本受控且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Average segmentation accuracy and model count do not reveal whether models fail on the same cases. We present CoFailMed, an audit of correlated failures in pretrained-encoder pools for medical segmentation. Across five 2D tasks, we evaluate 11 public pretrained encoders (a controlled sample, not a census) using frozen features and separately trained $1\times 1$ readouts with four seeds per encoder. Shared-checkpoint pairs have the highest mean per-case Dice correlation. An expanded 17-encoder analysis shows that distinct checkpoints within the same encoder family remain more correlated than cross-family pairs. At the pooled 33rd-percentile Dice threshold, four-member pools drawn from distinct encoders have mean effective sizes of 1.56-2.92, estimated from failure correlations in pools with enough failures and passes per member. In the primary pool, richer readouts and fine-tuning narrow the Dice-correlation gap between pairs sharing a checkpoint (or the DINOv2-B/S release) and all other pairs. Yet dependence between different encoders can increase, and fine-tuning does not consistently increase effective pool size at 33rd-percentile thresholds recomputed for each training recipe. A smaller between-group gap can coexist with greater dependence. Pool evaluation should therefore report absolute dependence and threshold-specific effective size alongside accuracy and nominal pool size. The CoFailMed release provides aligned per-case traces, analysis scripts and study code to reproduce the central audit results.
zh_abstract: 平均分割准确率和模型数量并不能揭示模型是否在相同病例上失败。我们提出 CoFailMed，对医学分割预训练编码器池中的相关失败进行审计。在五个 2D 任务中，我们评估 11 个公开预训练编码器（受控样本，而非普查），使用冻结特征和分别训练的 1×1 读出（readouts），每个编码器使用四个种子。共享检查点配对具有最高的平均逐病例 Dice 相关性。扩展的 17 编码器分析显示，同一编码器家族内的不同检查点仍比跨家族配对更相关。在合并的 33 百分位 Dice 阈值下，由不同编码器抽取的四成员池的平均有效规模为 1.56-2.92，其估计来自每个成员有足够失败和通过样本的池中的失败相关性。在主要池中，更丰富的读出和微调缩小了共享检查点（或 DINOv2-B/S 发布版）的配对与所有其他配对之间的 Dice 相关性差距。然而，不同编码器之间的依赖性可能增加，并且微调在每个训练配方重新计算的 33 百分位阈值下并不一致地增大有效池规模。较小的组间差距可以与更大的依赖性并存。因此，池评估应在准确率和名义池规模之外，报告绝对依赖性和特定阈值下的有效规模。CoFailMed 发布版提供对齐的逐病例轨迹、分析脚本和研究代码，以复现核心审计结果。

title: VectorCAM: A Digital Innovation to Advance Entomological Surveillance
zh_title: VectorCAM：AI蚊虫监测工具在乌干达的对照试验
summary: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学注册的一项已完成干预试验，在乌干达比较AI手机工具VectorCam与专业显微镜鉴定在蚊虫监测中的表现。

社区卫生工作者使用，对照为标准专家鉴定
注册信息显示样本48人，尚无结果

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Johns Hopkins University; conditions: Malaria, Surveillance, Entomology, Vector-Borne Diseases; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 48; status: COMPLETED] Mosquitoes spread diseases such as malaria, but tracking mosquito populations is often slow and depends on a small number of highly trained specialists. VectorCam is a smartphone-based tool that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help identify mosquitoes from photographs and automatically report surveillance information. In this study, community health workers in Uganda used VectorCam during routine mosquito collection activities, while a comparison group followed standard methods that required mosquito identification by trained specialists using microscopes. The study evaluated how accurately mosquitoes could be identified, how quickly information could be reported, how complete the collected data were, and how easy the system was to use. The goal was to determine whether AI-enabled technology could help communities collect and share mosquito surveillance information more quickly and efficiently, while maintaining data quality under real-world conditions.
zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：约翰斯·霍普金斯大学；疾病/条件：疟疾、监测、昆虫学、媒介传播疾病；类型：干预性研究；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：48；状态：已完成】蚊子传播疟疾等疾病，但追踪蚊虫种群往往缓慢，且依赖少数训练有素的专家。VectorCam 是一款基于智能手机的工具，利用人工智能（AI）帮助从照片中识别蚊虫并自动上报监测信息。在本研究中，乌干达的社区卫生工作者在日常蚊虫采集活动中使用 VectorCam，而对照组则采用标准方法，即由受过培训的专家使用显微镜进行蚊虫鉴定。该研究评估了蚊虫鉴定的准确程度、信息上报的速度、所采集数据的完整性以及系统的易用性。其目标是确定在真实世界条件下，AI 赋能的技术能否在保持数据质量的同时，帮助社区更快速、更高效地采集和共享蚊虫监测信息。

title: Artificial intelligence-assisted spectral microbiology for rapid microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction: advances, challenges, and future perspectives.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease
zh_title: AI辅助光谱微生物鉴定与耐药预测综述
summary: 综述AI结合质谱、拉曼与红外光谱等技术用于微生物鉴定和耐药预测的进展与挑战。
key_points: 覆盖MALDI-TOF、拉曼、红外与高光谱成像等模态
涵盖光谱预处理、特征工程与机器学习流程
讨论该方向的现状挑战与前景
reason: 同行评审综述，无原始数据与新验证，按综述档位定于增量档
abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Rapid microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction are fundamental to precision diagnostics, effective infection control, and antimicrobial stewardship. Artificial intelligence-assisted spectral microbiology is increasingly being investigated to convert complex spectral and imaging data into rapid microbiological identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction outputs. This review critically examines the integration of AI with matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry, Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, ultraviolet-visible-near-infrared spectroscopy, hyperspectral imaging, and automated colony imaging for microbial identification, strain discrimination, and AMR prediction. This work focuses on spectral preprocessing, feature engineering, machine-learning architectures, interpretability, validation, and clinical translation. Emerging evidence shows substantial potential to accelerate diagnostics while improving analytical precision and scalability. Nevertheless, dataset heterogeneity, instrument-dependent variability, limited external validation, and insufficient model transparency continue to constrain real-world adoption. Future integration of multimodal spectral, genomic, and clinical data could deliver robust, explainable, and interoperable diagnostic systems. It may support precision microbiology and antimicrobial-resistance surveillance, provided standardized acquisition, external validation, quality control, and uncertainty-aware interpretation are in place.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostic Microbiology and Infectious Disease] 快速微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性预测是精准诊断、有效感染控制和抗菌药物管理的基石。人工智能（AI）辅助的光谱微生物学正日益被研究用于将复杂的光谱和成像数据转化为快速微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）预测输出。本综述批判性审视AI与基质辅助激光解吸/电离飞行时间质谱、拉曼光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、紫外-可见-近红外光谱、高光谱成像和自动化菌落成像的整合，用于微生物鉴定、菌株区分和AMR预测。本工作聚焦于光谱预处理、特征工程、机器学习架构、可解释性、验证和临床转化。新兴证据显示其在加速诊断同时提高分析精度和可扩展性方面具有巨大潜力。然而，数据集异质性、仪器依赖变异性、外部验证有限和模型透明度不足继续制约真实世界应用。未来整合多模态光谱、基因组和临床数据，可能带来稳健、可解释且可互操作的诊断系统。只要具备标准化采集、外部验证、质量控制和不确定性感知解读，它可能支持精准微生物学和抗菌药物耐药性监测。

title: Building on the 2025 National Academies Pharmacy Workshop: Preparing Pharmacists for Technology-Driven Roles.
source: PubMed · American journal of pharmaceutical education
zh_title: 面向技术驱动角色的药师能力培养框架
summary: 基于2025年NASEM药学研讨会，提出药师需具备验证AI建议等能力，并给出四域纵向培养框架。
key_points: 药师需验证AI建议并实施数字疗法
提出四个纵向递进的能力域
用于PharmD课程与能力培养设计
reason: 教育框架类观点文章，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [American journal of pharmaceutical education] To identify the competencies that pharmacists need to evaluate, implement, and oversee technology-enabled care and propose a longitudinal framework for developing these competencies within PharmD education. Drawing on the 2025 National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine (NASEM) Pharmacy Workshop, this paper links emerging technologies to new pharmacist roles across clinical, regulatory, managed care, and industry settings. The new technologies demand that pharmacists validate artificial intelligence (AI) recommendations, implement digital therapeutics, apply pharmacogenomic (PGx) data, and interpret real-world evidence (RWE), all of which extend beyond traditional pharmacotherapy training. We propose four longitudinally scaffolded domains: Technical Understanding, Critical Evaluation, Ethical and Professional Stewardship, and Discipline-Specific Application. Technology is not diminishing the pharmacist's role. Rather, it highlights the importance of pharmacists' clinical expertise. Preparing graduates requires deliberate curricular design, faculty investment, and recognition that clinical judgment remains the irreplaceable complement to any algorithm.

abstract: Objective To develop and evaluate Pheno+, an electronic health record (EHR)-integrated application that streamlines the generation of structured phenotypes for genomic testing and analysis. Materials and Methods We developed Pheno+ as a Substitutable Medical Applications and Reusable Technologies on Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (SMART on FHIR) application embedded within the University of Utah Health EHR. Pheno+ retrieves clinician-selected clinical notes and applies ClinPhen, a natural language processing tool that identifies candidate Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms from clinical text. Clinicians review and curate the resulting HPO terms within the EHR. We used an eight case crossover design to compare total workflow time and HPO term counts between Pheno+ and a standard workflow involving physician chart review followed by HPO term selection by a molecular geneticist. In a separate cohort of 17 patients with confirmed monogenic diagnoses, we evaluated the utility of Pheno+-derived HPO terms for diagnostic gene prioritization by comparing Exomiser performance with and without phenotype input. Results Pheno+ reduced mean total workflow time by 66%, from 31.1 to 10.5 minutes (p < 0.001). Exomiser ranked the causative gene first in all 17 cases (100%) using Pheno+-derived HPO terms. Discussion and Conclusion Pheno+ reduced the time and personnel required to generate clinician-curated HPO term lists while producing phenotypes that provided meaningful diagnostic information for downstream genomic analyses. These findings support EHR-integrated, clinician-in-the-loop phenotyping for genomic workflows.

abstract: Objective: 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (22q11DS) is the leading genetic cause of palatal anomalies, presenting a heterogeneous spectrum of clinical manifestations that complicates early diagnosis. No study has systematically investigated the co-occurrence of symptoms spanning cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric, craniofacial, immune, endocrine, renal, and familial domains within a single cohort using unsupervised learning methods for 22q11DS stratification. This study proposes a pipeline to identify subgroups and associated symptom patterns from binary clinical data, aiming to improve screening and referral for genetic testing. Design: Cross-sectional, retrospective study comparing three unsupervised clustering frameworks, K-medoids, DBSCAN, and Latent Class Analysis (LCA), followed by association rule mining applied to individuals with confirmed deletion. Setting: Brazilian Database of Craniofacial Anomalies (BBAC), a national clinical registry. Participants: A cohort of 297 individuals with suspected 22q11DS. Main Outcome Measures: Cluster separability (silhouette coefficient), characterization of phenotypic subgroups, and sensitivity/specificity of the current screening protocol stratified by subgroup. Results: LCA achieved the highest cluster separability (silhouette = 0.165), yielding four distinct subgroups: Cardiac-predominant (C0), Craniofacial-palatal (C1), Neurodevelopmental-psychiatric (C2), and Mild- craniofacial (C3). Cluster coherence was confirmed by medical specialists. Quantitative protocol assessment revealed adequate overall sensitivity, with markedly lower performance for C2 and C3, identifying profiles at higher risk of being missed by current screening criteria. Conclusions: These findings provide a data-driven basis for recalibrating symptom weights and referral thresholds, improving sensitivity for underperforming subgroups while reducing unnecessary referrals, optimizing the balance between diagnostic coverage and the financial burden of genetic testing.
zh_abstract: 【目的】22q11.2缺失综合征（22q11DS）是腭部异常的首要遗传病因，其临床表现呈异质性谱系，使早期诊断复杂化。尚无研究在单一队列中采用无监督学习方法对22q11DS进行分层，系统探讨跨越心血管、神经精神、颅面、免疫、内分泌、肾脏和家族领域的症状共现。本研究提出一种流程，从二分类临床数据中识别亚组及相关症状模式，旨在改善筛查和转诊进行基因检测。【设计】横断面、回顾性研究，比较三种无监督聚类框架：K-medoids、DBSCAN和潜类别分析（LCA），随后对确诊缺失个体应用关联规则挖掘。【地点】巴西颅面异常数据库（BBAC），一个全国性临床登记库。【参与者】由297名疑似22q11DS个体组成的队列。【主要结局指标】聚类可分性（轮廓系数）、表型亚组特征描述，以及当前筛查方案按亚组分层的灵敏度/特异度。【结果】LCA获得最高聚类可分性（轮廓系数=0.165），产生四个不同亚组：心脏为主型（C0）、颅面-腭型（C1）、神经发育-精神型（C2）和轻度颅面型（C3）。医学专家确认了聚类一致性。定量方案评估显示总体灵敏度尚可，但C2和C3表现明显较低，识别出更可能被当前筛查标准漏诊的特征谱。【结论】这些发现为重新校准症状权重和转诊阈值提供了数据驱动基础，提高表现不佳亚组的灵敏度，同时减少不必要转诊，优化诊断覆盖与基因检测经济负担之间的平衡。

abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) under a fixed accelerator budget requires jointly deciding how computational capacity is allocated across model sizes and how incoming requests are routed across that capacity. Although prior work has extensively studied LLM routing and serving efficiency, the relative importance of fleet composition and routing under resource constraints remains less understood. We investigate this question using a controlled four-GPU serving environment with heterogeneous clinical NLP workloads spanning short factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization. We systematically vary fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load while holding the workload trace and hardware budget fixed. Across 24 configurations, descriptive main-effect shares attribute more variation to fleet composition than to the evaluated routing policies in time to first token, latency, and long-context coverage. All-small fleets provide the best responsiveness and throughput but substantially lower long-context coverage, whereas larger-model capacity improves coverage at the cost of serving efficiency. Heterogeneous fleets provide intermediate operating points but can introduce strong-model bottlenecks when large-model capacity is scarce. In a focused evaluation of this bottleneck, capacity-aware routing reduces mean latency and increases throughput while incurring a small reduction in long-context coverage. Within this measured regime, the results support prioritizing capacity allocation, with routing managing demand within the provisioned capacity.
zh_abstract: 在固定的加速器预算下部署大语言模型（LLMs），需要共同决定计算容量如何在模型规模之间分配，以及传入请求如何在该容量上路由。尽管先前工作已广泛研究 LLM 路由和服务效率，但在资源约束下，机群组成（fleet composition）和路由的相对重要性仍较少被理解。我们使用受控的四 GPU 服务环境研究这一问题，工作负载为异构临床 NLP 任务，涵盖简短事实核查、生物医学语义匹配和长上下文临床摘要。我们系统改变机群组成、路由策略和提供的负载，同时保持工作负载轨迹和硬件预算固定。在 24 种配置中，描述性主效应份额表明，在首 token 时间（time to first token）、延迟和长上下文覆盖率方面，机群组成比所评估的路由策略贡献了更多变异。全小型机群提供最佳响应性和吞吐量，但长上下文覆盖率显著较低，而较大模型容量可提高覆盖率，代价是服务效率。异构机群提供中间运行点，但当大型模型容量稀缺时可能引入强模型瓶颈。在对该瓶颈的集中评估中，容量感知路由降低了平均延迟并提高了吞吐量，同时导致长上下文覆盖率小幅下降。在该测量范围内，结果支持优先考虑容量分配，由路由在所配置容量内管理需求。

abstract: [The Journal of nursing administration] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly integrating into health care delivery, influencing clinical, operational, and strategic decision-making. Nurse executives must therefore possess competencies that enable informed oversight of AI-enabled systems. This article proposes an AI literacy competency framework for nurse executive practice, adapted from existing AI literacy scholarship and aligned with nursing leadership responsibilities. The framework provides a conceptual foundation for integrating AI literacy into leadership competency development, translating theoretical constructs into practice that is aligned with executive decision-making. The framework also defines knowledge, skills, and attitudes necessary for ethical governance, evaluation, and responsible implementation of AI in health care organizations. In doing so, it offers a structured approach for preparing nurse leaders to guide the responsible adoption and oversight of AI-enabled technologies.

abstract: Phase I dose-finding trials must learn from sparse toxicity observations while limiting exposure to overly toxic doses. We develop a single reinforcement-learning policy for trials with different numbers of ordered dose levels. Each dose is represented as a token containing its normalized position, accumulated patient count, observed dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs), and current-dose indicator. A Transformer encoder summarizes the dose tokens, trial-conditioned cross-attention produces a fixed-dimensional trial representation, and a three-action policy chooses de-escalation, staying, or escalation. The final maximum tolerated dose (MTD) decision is deliberately kept outside the learned policy: after the planned sample size, weighted isotonic regression and a prespecified safety cap select the dose closest to the target toxicity probability. In the simulations, toxicity-penalized policies reduce DLT burden while unpenalized policies improve selection accuracy at the cost of greater toxicity. These results demonstrate a controllable safety--accuracy trade-off but do not establish superiority over conventional dose-finding designs.
zh_abstract: I期剂量探索试验必须从稀疏的毒性观察中学习，同时限制对过度毒性剂量的暴露。我们为具有不同数量有序剂量水平的试验开发单一强化学习策略。每个剂量表示为一个token，包含其归一化位置、累计患者数、观察到的剂量限制性毒性（DLTs）以及当前剂量指示符。Transformer编码器汇总剂量token，以试验为条件的交叉注意力生成固定维度的试验表示，三动作策略选择降剂量、维持或升剂量。最终的最大耐受剂量（MTD）决策被有意保留在学习策略之外：在达到计划样本量后，加权保序回归和预设安全性上限选择最接近目标毒性概率的剂量。在模拟中，毒性惩罚策略减轻DLT负担，而未惩罚策略以更高毒性为代价提高选择准确性。这些结果证明了可控的安全性-准确性权衡，但并未确立其优于传统剂量探索设计。

abstract: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) is critical for medical image segmentation as it adapts a model to an unlabeled target domain without accessing source data, thereby preserving data privacy. However, its effectiveness is often limited by confirmation bias: self-training models tend to miss small polyps, hallucinate foreground, and produce imprecise contours. We propose MedRT-SFSeg, a real-time SFDA framework built on a dual-head one-to-one/one-to-many YOLO segmentation architecture. Mask-DHF fuses precision- and recall-oriented predictions into stable pseudo-instances, while DURR uses the sign of pixel-level dual-head disagreement as a directional cue to expand or shrink masks, and additionally recovers missed instances and suppresses hallucinations. Seg-MARD further regularizes feature representations through mask-guided, region-stratified sampling. Experiments on bidirectional adaptation between Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB show that MedRT-SFSeg achieves 80.43%/80.77% Dice and 5.53/8.44 mm ASD, improving the non-adapted baseline by 7.7 and 9.8 Dice points while running at more than 62 FPS end-to-end. These results suggest that segmentation-aware dual-head supervision can improve pseudo-label quality without sacrificing real-time inference. zh_abstract: 无源域自适应（Source-free domain adaptation, SFDA）对医学图像分割至关重要，因为它可在不访问源数据的情况下使模型自适应到无标签目标域，从而保护数据隐私。然而，其有效性常受确认偏误限制：自训练模型容易漏检小息肉、幻觉出前景并产生不精确的轮廓。我们提出 MedRT-SFSeg，一个基于双头一对一/一对多 YOLO 分割架构构建的实时 SFDA 框架。Mask-DHF 将偏向精确率和召回率的预测融合为稳定的伪实例，而 DURR 利用像素级双头分歧的符号作为方向线索来扩张或收缩掩码，并额外恢复漏检实例、抑制幻觉。Seg-MARD 进一步通过掩码引导、区域分层采样来正则化特征表示。在 Kvasir-SEG 与 CVC-ClinicDB 之间双向自适应的实验表明，MedRT-SFSeg 达到 80.43%/80.77% Dice 和 5.53/8.44 mm ASD，相比未自适应基线提升 7.7 和 9.8 个 Dice 点，同时端到端运行速度超过 62 FPS。这些结果表明，分割感知的双头监督可在不牺牲实时推理的情况下提高伪标签质量。项目页面：https://danielnguyen-05.github.io/MedRT-SFSeg

abstract: Chronic kidney disease is characterized by structural alterations in renal tissue and progressive loss of kidney function. While glomerular subtype ratios provide a compact and clinically meaningful summary of glomerular composition, representing pathomic information using whole-slide image (WSI)-level mean values diminishes glomerulus-level heterogeneity and the contribution of less prevalent patterns. In this proof-of-concept study, we investigated whether modeling individual glomeruli using multiple-instance learning (MIL) could provide complementary information to conventional subtype ratios for estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) classification. We analyzed 162 kidney-biopsy WSIs from 162 patients, categorizing renal function as eGFR = 60 mL/min/1.73 m^2. Quantitative size, shape, intensity, and texture features were extracted from segmented glomeruli, representing each patient as a bag of glomerular instances. An attention-based MIL model was trained to aggregate these heterogeneous pathomic profiles. We evaluated subtype ratios, pathomics, and their combination using ABMIL, with a mean-pooled multilayer perceptron baseline. In five-fold cross-validation, the subtype-ratio-only model achieved an AUC of 0.7262 +/- 0.0596. MIL using pathomics alone achieved an AUC of 0.7362 +/- 0.0788, whereas integrating pathomics with subtype ratios produced the highest mean AUC of 0.7630 +/- 0.0665. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to examine individual feature contributions. These results demonstrate that MIL-based pathomics can complement established glomerular subtype ratios by capturing additional glomerulus-level information for quantitative kidney-biopsy analysis.
zh_abstract: 慢性肾脏病的特征是肾组织结构改变和肾功能进行性丧失。虽然肾小球亚型比例提供了对肾小球组成的紧凑且具有临床意义的总结，但使用全切片图像（whole-slide image, WSI）水平均值来表示病理组学信息会削弱肾小球水平异质性以及较少见模式的贡献。在这项概念验证研究中，我们探讨了使用多实例学习（multiple-instance learning, MIL）对单个肾小球建模，是否能为估算肾小球滤过率（estimated glomerular filtration rate, eGFR）分类提供与传统亚型比例互补的信息。我们分析了来自162例患者的162张肾脏活检WSI，以eGFR = 60 mL/min/1.73 m^2对肾功能进行分类。从分割出的肾小球中提取定量的大小、形状、强度和纹理特征，将每例患者表示为一个肾小球实例包。训练了一个基于注意力的MIL模型来聚合这些异质性病理组学特征。我们使用ABMIL评估了亚型比例、病理组学及其组合，并设置了均值池化多层感知机基线。在五折交叉验证中，仅使用亚型比例的模型AUC为0.7262 +/- 0.0596。仅使用病理组学的MIL AUC为0.7362 +/- 0.0788，而将病理组学与亚型比例整合后产生了最高的平均AUC，为0.7630 +/- 0.0665。使用SHapley加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations, SHAP）检查个体特征贡献。这些结果表明，基于MIL的病理组学可通过捕获额外的肾小球水平信息来补充已有的肾小球亚型比例，用于定量肾脏活检分析。

title: Enhancing Medical Lesion Segmentation via Several Simple Modules
zh_title: 轻量模块增强医学病灶分割
summary: 提出三个轻量增强模块用于医学病灶分割，面向数据稀缺与算力受限场景。
key_points: 提出DT-Morph组合损失等三个轻量模块
针对稀有病灶标注不足与形态畸变

abstract: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. To address these challenges, we first propose DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling to optimize differentiable topological structures and boundary continuity. Second, we introduce 3D Group Prompt, which extracts domain-universal knowledge via curated volumetric image-mask alignment prompts together with text prompts built on SAT baseline. Finally, we replace conventional output layers with Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head equipped with synonym-resolved routing, which brings negligible computational cost and enables fast incremental learning for new categories without sacrificing performance on old tasks. Ablation studies on abdominal and extra-abdominal datasets covering both organ and lesion segmentation verify the efficacy of our modules.
zh_abstract: 本工作为医学病变分割引入三个轻量级增强模块，以提升临床适用性，尤其是在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境中。当前主流方法难以应对罕见病理缺乏高质量标注的问题，这常常导致推理过程中出现严重的形态失真，尽管其取得了看似理想的DSC分数。此外，各个分割任务的孤立开发限制了跨域方法创新，凸显了利用同一解剖区域内不同病变之间共享知识的必要性。然而，历史数据和标注的获取受限阻碍了高效的知识提取，并在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为应对这些挑战，我们首先提出带有连续空间池化的DT-Morph Combined Loss（DT-Morph组合损失），以优化可微分拓扑结构和边界连续性。其次，我们引入3D Group Prompt，它通过精心构建的体图像-掩膜对齐提示，以及基于SAT基线构建的文本提示，提取领域通用知识。最后，我们用配备同义词解析路由的Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head（多对一条件分割头）替换传统输出层，其计算成本可忽略不计，并能实现新类别的快速增量学习，同时不牺牲旧任务上的性能。在涵盖器官分割和病变分割的腹部及腹外数据集上进行的消融研究验证了我们模块的有效性。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Universidad Rey Juan Carlos; conditions: Neurologic Disorders; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 50; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Neurological diseases affect people's cognitive and physical abilities, limiting their functional independence and causing disability, which in many cases, is progressive and degenerative. Being able to perform activities of daily living is a challenge in these pathologies. Currently, different observational tools are administered to assess the degree of functional limitation in basic and instrumental Activities of Daily Living (ADL). However, the assessment must be performed in an ecological and real context to obtain objective information and ensure the most accurate assessment possible. To this end, it is necessary to consider the factors that influence the performance of ADLs and also on the quality of their execution, especially in this population in which the stressful situation of direct observation by an evaluator has a direct influence on the final score. NeurEYE aims to develop technological tools to extract from sensory systems typical of intelligent spaces and with the help of signal processing and machine learning processes based on artificial intelligence, indicators of neurological impairment that influence functional capacity and function/dysfunction components while observing the performance of an activity of daily living. In addition, NeurEYE would provide as a scientific breakthrough the accurate description of subjects' limitations in the controlled assessment environment within the routine patient context. The NeurEye project will allow the clinical validation of a multisensory system that, through the detection of functional limitations in the ADLs of patients with neurological disorder, allows to establish the level of disability of the subjects. In addition, the qualitative and quantitative description of the functional alterations of the person with neurological disorders and, the elimination of the subjective bias of the examiner, will allow the generation of individualized clinical and statistical reports according to sex, activity, etc. that will be clinically useful in the early detection, diagnosis, and adaptation of rehabilitation treatments to the specific functional needs of neurological disorders.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Universidad Rey Juan Carlos；疾病：神经系统疾病；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：50；状态：尚未开始招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 神经系统疾病影响人的认知和身体能力，限制其功能独立性并导致残疾，许多情况下是进行性和退行性的。在这些疾病中，能够完成日常生活活动是一项挑战。目前，使用不同的观察性工具来评估基本日常生活活动和工具性日常生活活动（Activities of Daily Living，ADL）中的功能受限程度。然而，评估必须在生态化和真实的情境中进行，以获得客观信息并确保尽可能准确的评估。为此，有必要考虑影响ADL表现及其执行质量的因素，尤其是在该人群中，评估者直接观察所带来的应激情境会直接影响最终评分。NeurEYE旨在开发技术工具，从智能空间典型的感官系统中，并在基于人工智能的信号处理和机器学习过程的帮助下，提取影响功能能力和功能/功能障碍组成部分的神经功能损害指标，同时观察一项日常生活活动的执行情况。此外，NeurEYE将作为一项科学突破，在常规患者情境中的受控评估环境里准确描述受试者的局限性。NeurEye项目将实现一个多感官系统的临床验证；该系统通过检测神经系统疾病患者ADL中的功能受限，能够确定受试者的残疾水平。此外，对神经系统疾病患者功能改变的定性和定量描述，以及消除检查者的主观偏倚，将能够生成按性别、活动等分类的个体化临床和统计报告，这些报告将在早期发现、诊断以及根据神经系统疾病的特定功能需求调整康复治疗方面具有临床实用性。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Gazi University; conditions: Nursing Students; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 49; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Artificial intelligence is a rapidly developing technology in today's digital age and has had transformative effects in many areas, from education to healthcare. The use of AI in education offers personalized learning experiences and interactive learning environments by introducing new approaches to learning processes . This environment aims to take advantage of the opportunities offered by AI in nursing education to improve students' professional knowledge and skills and prepare them for future healthcare environments. Nursing processes, a fundamental component of nursing education, help nurses develop clinical decision-making, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills by enabling a systematic and holistic approach to patient care . However, traditional teaching methods may sometimes be insufficient to effectively support students in learning and applying these complex processes . The integration of artificial intelligence into nursing processes can help students acquire these essential skills more effectively and efficiently. Advanced language processing models such as ChatGPT provide nursing students with an interactive learning environment to analyze complex clinical scenarios, identify appropriate nursing diagnoses, and create personalized care plans . Previous studies investigating the integration of chatbot-based or AI-powered tools in nursing education have predominantly used non-experimental, descriptive, or quasi-experimental designs . These studies have generally reported improvements in students' critical thinking, learning motivation, and attitudes toward technology; however, they have tended to focus on a single outcome. Considering these shortcomings, the present study aimed to evaluate the effect of ChatGPT training in the nursing process on the perception of nursing diagnoses and critical thinking of final year nursing students using ChatGPT in the nursing process, within the framework of a randomized controlled trial.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Gazi University；疾病/条件：护理学生；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；阶段：NA；入组人数：49；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION（招募中，仅限邀请）] 人工智能是当今数字时代快速发展的技术，已在从教育到医疗保健的许多领域产生变革性影响。在教育中使用AI通过为学习过程引入新方法，提供个性化学习体验和交互式学习环境。该环境旨在利用AI在护理教育中提供的机会，提高学生的专业知识和技能，并为未来医疗保健环境做好准备。护理过程是护理教育的基本组成部分，通过使患者护理采用系统化和整体化方法，帮助护士培养临床决策、问题解决和批判性思维能力。然而，传统教学方法有时可能不足以有效支持学生学习和应用这些复杂过程。将人工智能整合到护理过程中可以帮助学生更有效、更高效地获得这些基本技能。诸如ChatGPT之类的高级语言处理模型为护理学生提供交互式学习环境，以分析复杂临床情景、识别适当的护理诊断并制定个性化护理计划。先前研究在护理教育中整合基于聊天机器人或AI驱动的工具时，主要采用非实验性、描述性或准实验性设计。这些研究通常报告学生的批判性思维、学习动机和对技术的态度有所改善；然而，它们往往侧重于单一结局。考虑到这些不足，本研究旨在随机对照试验框架内，评估在护理过程中使用ChatGPT的培训对最后学年护理学生护理诊断感知和批判性思维的影响。
